title: Universal Banker RBWM
description:
Location- Altrincham, Stamford New Road

Work Pattern- Office working

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This is a branch-based, customer-facing role focused on generating revenue by meeting the needs of Personal Banking and Advance customers while providing service where required. You’ll use a structured sales approach to understand what matters to each customer and match them to the right HSBC products and services where regulation permits. The role also plays a key part in bringing new customers to HSBC and strengthening existing relationships through helpful, consistent interactions. You’ll encourage customers to use the most suitable channels for their needs, including digital options while maintaining a high standard of in-branch support. Success means delivering excellent customer experience, completing product sales responsibly and making effective referrals to specialist teams based on customer needs. You’ll also contribute to the wider performance of the branch through day-to-day support and risk awareness.

What you'll be doing

  • Welcome customers on branch entry and use structured conversations to understand their needs
  • Acquiring new-to-bank customers through effective in-branch engagement
  • Develop existing customer relationships by identifying opportunities to meet evolving banking needs
  • Deliver consistently excellent customer experience and service where required
  • Promote multi-channel engagement and guide customers to additional channels where appropriate
  • Complete product sales except material risk products where regulation permits
  • Apply the EDRAS based sales process to discover needs and recommend suitable solutions
  • Provide referrals to Wealth Sales and Branch Specialists based on customer needs

What we're looking for

  • Bring experience in a customer-facing sales and service role with a focus on meeting customer needs
  • Apply a structured approach to needs-based conversations and product recommendation
  • Demonstrate capability in generating revenue through appropriate product sales and relationship deepening
  • Build new customer relationships and convert interest into long-term engagement with the bank
  • Promote digital and multi-channel options in a way that supports consistently good customer experience
  • Make effective referrals to specialist colleagues based on customer needs
  • Follow regulatory and policy requirements when selling products and providing customer support
  • Protect the bank through vigilance against fraud, knowing your customer and managing operational risk in day-to-day activity

Building stronger customer relationships

If you want your work to have a clear outcome each day for customers and for the branch this role offers real scope to make that impact. You’ll help customers make informed choices, connect them to the right products and services and introduce them to additional channels that fit their needs. You’ll also work closely with colleagues across the branch and specialist teams to make sure customers get the right support at the right time. If this sounds like the kind of role where you can do your best work, we’d welcome your application.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com.

title: Manufacturing Operator (Chemical Mixing) (Afternoon Shift)
description:
Job Title: Manufacturing Operator (Chemical Mixing)

Company: Axalta

Job #: 2026-19991

Industry: Manufacturing (Paint, Coatings, Chemicals)

Location: Madison, AL

Shift: (3:00pm -11:30pm M-F)

Salary: $22.00 Hourly

Education: High School Diploma Required

Background: Must be able to pass a Background Check & Drug Screen (NO EXCEPTIONS)

Important: Candidates will train on 1’st shift and after training will move to 2’nd shift (3:00pm to 11:30pm)

Important: We are seeking candidates with at least 2 years Manufacturing (Plant, Industrial) experience. Experience with Chemical Mixing or Batch making is highly preferred.

(Company Website Link)

Job Description:

The Huntsville, AL plant is looking for a Plant Operator who is action oriented, can make quality decisions quickly and possess excellent trouble shooting skills. The successful candidate in an Operator position will be trained in all facets of production (pre-mixing and material loading for batches, filling product into shipping containers, distribution, testing, sampling, and cleaning) to learn these essential duties of the position. The incumbent must operate production equipment safely to ensure the highest quality and correct quantity in accordance with the production schedule, standard operating procedures and supervisory instructions. Position duties and responsibilities can change regularly based on business needs. Operators will understand the mechanics of how to operate various types of equipment with confidence. Types of equipment include but are not limited to, labeler, filler machines, air pumps, high speed dispersers, air mixers, and weight scales within the department. Solve routine problems associated with job responsibilities. Ensures the highest product quality possible while adhering to all safety, environmental and work rules.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Performs all duties in a safe working manner, following all of the Company safety policies and procedures
  • Blend batch to designated formula
  • Learn how to fill-off batches and fill batches
  • Record all adjustments made to batches
  • Upon completion of batch make sure work area is cleaned up
  • Follow batch fill-out instructions as they relate to filter/straining requirements, container requirements, agitation of material requirements and labeling requirements
  • Select approved batches to be filled by ship date or supervisors' instructions
  • Set up filtering equipment per batch ticket instructions and operate filling equipment
  • Operate PLC Directly responsible for housekeeping and control of waste generation
  • Operation of powered material handling equipment (PMHE) to move, store, load, and unload hazardous finished product(s) Unloading and loading of bulk

Required:

  • High School Diploma
  • Math and problem-solving; mechanical, numerical and verbal aptitude to learn our jobs quickly
  • Ability to be licensed to operate fork trucks
  • Demonstrated ability to demonstrate collaboration skills and work within self-managed team environment
  • Must be able to read and follow, weight fractions of ounces, and measure accurately by gallons, pints and ounces (good math skills)

Preferred:

  • Chemical plant/paint making experience
  • Able to demonstrate basic computer skills,
  • Prior experience operating fork trucks

Our Company:


Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.


Axalta may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review.

title: Advancement Services Data Specialist
description:
Join the Saint Mary’s College Community!

Saint Mary’s College, a distinguished Catholic women’s college known for its commitment to educating and empowering women, offers a welcoming and collaborative environment where meaningful work makes a difference. As part of the Advancement team, you’ll help strengthen the connections between the College, its alumnae, and its generous supporters.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, service-minded professional to join our team as an Advancement Services Data Specialist. In this role, you’ll play an important part in supporting fundraising efforts, maintaining accurate donor records, and creating positive experiences for alumnae and donors. If you enjoy keeping things organized, working with data, supporting special events, and helping a team achieve its goals, we invite you to apply and become part of the Saint Mary’s College community!

The Advancement Services Data Specialist provides administrative, operational, and data support for Saint Mary’s College Advancement Services and Alumnae Relations. Reporting to the Director of Advancement Services, this position supports the systems, processes, and workflows that sustain fundraising and alumnae engagement.

Responsibilities include maintaining accurate constituent, alumnae, donor, and gift records; assisting with gift processing, donor acknowledgments, stewardship, and reporting; supporting alumnae communications, events, and volunteer engagement; and providing general administrative support for Advancement Services and Alumnae Relations.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a strong commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, customer service, and continuous process improvement. This position plays an important role in maintaining data integrity, supporting operational excellence, and strengthening relationships with donors, alumnae, volunteers, and the broader College community.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Maintaining and updating constituent, alumnae, donor, and organizational records in College database systems.
  • Processing gifts, pledges, and charitable contributions in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Supporting donor acknowledgment, receipting, stewardship, recognition, and engagement activities.
  • Generating reports, queries, lists, and data extracts to support fundraising, events, and alumnae engagement.
  • Assisting with data audits, record reviews, and quality-control efforts to ensure database accuracy.
  • Preparing correspondence, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, mailings, and other administrative materials.
  • Coordinating communications and responding professionally to routine inquiries from donors, alumnae, volunteers, and campus constituents.
  • Providing logistical and administrative support for Reunion, alumnae events, donor events, meetings, and other Advancement Division initiatives.
  • Assisting with event registration, attendee tracking, volunteer engagement, and constituent outreach.
  • Maintaining departmental files, documentation, and records retention processes.
  • Supporting operational workflows and documenting business processes, procedures, and data entry standards.
  • Training and providing guidance to student workers as assigned.
  • Performing other duties and special projects as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree or certificate in business, office administration, accounting, information management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Two or more years of administrative, database, customer service, advancement, nonprofit, or related office experience.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive constituent, donor, financial, and institutional information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications.
  • Experience working with database systems.
  • Strong research and problem-solving skills, including the ability to verify information and maintain accurate records.
  • Understanding of data integrity and accurate record management.
  • Ability to follow detailed procedures, apply established policies, and adapt processes to new situations.
  • Ability to document data entry standards, business processes, policies, and procedures.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Commitment to exceptional constituent service and the ability to build positive relationships with alumnae, donors, volunteers, and members of the College community.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with constituent relationship management (CRM) systems and reporting tools.
  • Experience in higher education advancement, fundraising, nonprofit operations, or alumnae relations.
  • Experience with gift processing, donor stewardship, acknowledgment, receipting, or fundraising reports.
  • Experience maintaining databases, conducting data audits, and supporting data quality initiatives.
  • Experience coordinating events, managing registrations, preparing communications, or supporting volunteer engagement.
  • Experience documenting procedures and improving administrative workflows.
  • Experience training or supervising student workers.

Schedule

  • 40 hours per week, 12 months per year.
  • Monday–Friday.
  • Onsite position.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require visa sponsorship from Saint Mary’s College, either now or in the future.

title: Immersive Simulation Technician
description:
Grand Canyon University! One of Arizona’s leading institutions of higher learning. Located in the Valley of Sun in the heart of Phoenix, Arizona, GCU is a regionally accredited, private, nondenominational Christian University.


Do you want to work collaboratively across all colleges, and with industry leaders to promote human flourishing? We are especially interested in applicants who can strengthen the diversity of our academic community and integrate faith.

description:

title: Senior Client Service Representative
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Location: Kraków

Type of work: Full time

Hybrid model: Hybrid model 3 days per week in the office /2 days for a parent of a child up to 4 years old

Join us as a Senior Client Service Representative!

As a Senior Client Service Representative in Custody, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality client service and handling day-to-day client inquiries. You will act as a key point of contact for clients, ensuring timely, accurate, and clear communication.
This role requires strong ownership, attention to details, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. You will manage multiple priorities, collaborate with internal teams, and proactively resolve client issues. You are expected to take full ownership of assigned cases end-to-end and ensure a positive client experience.

On this position you will be responsible for:

  • Act as a key point of contact for assigned clients, providing timely, accurate, and clear responses to inquiries.
  • Manage client inquiries and cases end-to-end with full ownership, ensuring a positive client experience.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through professional communication and reliable service delivery.
  • Participate in client meetings and discussions, contributing updates, clarifications, and follow-up actions as needed.
  • Resolve complex client issues using structured problem-solving and strong attention to detail.
  • Identify root causes, risks, and blockers early, escalating appropriately with clear recommendations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and coordinate across teams to deliver effective outcomes.
  • Prioritize work based on client impact, urgency, and operational risk while managing multiple tasks effectively.
  • Ensure compliance with controls, procedures, and documentation standards.
  • Maintain strong product and process knowledge while supporting process improvements, projects, and team initiatives

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of custody or financial services experience - knowledge of custody products (corporate actions, equities, fixed income, derivatives) preferred
  • Experience in a client-facing environment: ability to manage client inquiries and deliver clear, timely responses
  • Fluent English
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and structured problem-solving approach, ability to operate effectively without clear procedures, feel comfortable with the unknown, and connect information to resolve cases
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and build relationships
  • Proficiency in using systems and tools to manage client inquiries and deliverables
  • Clients receive timely, accurate, and clear responses
  • Issues are resolved end-to-end with strong ownership
  • Work is delivered with high quality and attention to detail
  • Strong collaboration with internal teams supports effective outcomes
  • You contribute to improving processes and service delivery

What we offer:

  • To encourage cultural awareness and philanthropy, BBHers have 1 Culture Celebration Day and 1 Community Service Day in addition to their paid standard vacation allowance
  • Private medical care
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - offering independent and confidential counselling services for you and your family. You can get support for topics including family, marriage and relationships, finances, and legal issues.
  • Professional trainings and qualification support
  • Wellbeing Program
  • Online Social Fund benefit platform
  • Social, sport and integration events
  • Onboarding Program for new hires

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

We are seeking a skilled and detail‑oriented IT SAP ERP Plan‑to‑Make Functional Analyst with a strong manufacturing focus to join our company‑wide SAP support team. Remote, with an optional on‑site work location available in Melbourne, FL.

Requirement Analysis

Solution Design & Configuration

  • Design SAP solutions that meet manufacturing business needs.
  • Configure SAP ERP to enable required manufacturing processes and capabilities.
  • Partner with technical teams on necessary customizations or enhancements.

Implementation & Testing

  • Lead and participate in SAP manufacturing solution implementations.
  • Conduct thorough testing to ensure solutions meet requirements and function reliably.

User Training & Support

  • Train end users on new or enhanced manufacturing processes.
  • Provide ongoing support to resolve manufacturing‑related issues and maintain smooth system operations.

Documentation

  • Develop detailed documentation for SAP solutions, configurations, and processes.
  • Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date materials for future reference and training.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to enhance manufacturing processes, streamline capacity management, and strengthen system functionality.
  • Stay current on SAP updates, emerging capabilities, and manufacturing best practices.

Required Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven success as an SAP ERP Functional Analyst with expertise in manufacturing modules, including quality management (PP, QM, PS) and integration with FICO, SD, MM, IM, WM, and PM.
  • Deep understanding of SAP manufacturing processes and system configurations.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

Preferred Additional Qualifications:

  • SAP certification in manufacturing modules.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA and migrating from SAP ECC.
  • Knowledge of integration points between SAP manufacturing and other SAP modules.
  • Deeper experience with SAP ERP modules including MM, IM, WM.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work‑life balance.
  • Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.
  • An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.
  • The chance to be part of a mission‑driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

This is a temporary position.


Teledyne LeCroy Inc. develops leading edge test and measurement products. Engineering teams around the globe use our systems to develop next-generation communication, consumer electronics and computer products.


We are looking for a talented Senior QA Engineer with solid Bluetooth knowledge to join us as part of our Frontline Test Services Team, providing world-class interoperability and consultancy to Teledyne LeCroy customers.

This position will support our customers in using the industry’s leading-edge technologies and tools. The successful candidate will have the passion and technical aptitude to become a subject matter expert in the field of connectivity technologies, be self-motivated and be able to perform under pressure and deadlines.


As a Senior QA Engineer, you will be responsible for working with customers to provide detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases to ensure that products are bug free and provide a great customer experience.

In this role, you will be able to grow with us as you work with multiple teams. Also, you will have the ability to take technical specifications and clearly translate them into test requirements. You will be a subject matter expert and will have the ability to continue to grow into new technologies across service offerings.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate with customers to create work item plans to ensure work, deliverables and delivery dates are defined at start of each project
  • Continually track projects, ensuring that progress is as expected and ensure that issues can be mitigated
  • Provide verbal and written test reports to customers
  • Responsible for peer review and quality control of all test documentation
  • Provide Root Cause Analysis of defects substantiated with device logs and Over-the-air Capture Files
  • Is self-motivated and able to thrive under production pressure and deadlines
  • Demonstrate good interpersonal skills and can collaborate effectively with co-workers
  • Self-improvement training where required
  • Keep track of updates to technical specifications and report to customers if necessary
  • Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts to improve test efficiency and coverage
  • Mentor QA Team in technical matters

EDUCATION, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of working within a test or QA environment
  • 2+ years of software experience preferably in Python
  • BSc/BEng in Engineering or relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth protocols and how those protocols are implemented
  • Experience with Python programming
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Ability to perform well under pressure, to set and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
  • Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

  • Experience in interoperability testing
  • Experience with Bluetooth technologies and specifications
  • Experience using protocol analyzers and wireless sniffers
  • Experience with mobile consumer devices and/or automotive infotainment systems
  • Must be able to travel

title: Electronics Engineering Degree Apprentice
description:
Job Description:



The opportunity

Leonardo offers a range of Apprenticeships from 2-5yrs. across a variety of STEM and business routes, offering paid training, coupled with on the job learning that enables you to gain practical skills, experience and knowledge that sets up the best start to your career. We offer competitive entry salaries and fully support your academic learning through to qualifications, with salary increases as you progress.


We support helping you settle into your new location ensuring you are familiar with the team and have a warm welcome from day 1. There is a member of our Apprentice team at each site, helping you progress, ensuring your study time is protected, enabling access to digital learning as well as opportunities to get involved with the local community and STEM projects, enhance many aspects of each programme.


Programme Description

Looking for a great start to your career in Electronics Engineering, earning and learning on a professionally accredited, award-winning scheme? We are looking to recruit the experts of the future on our nationally recognised, award-winning Apprenticeship Programmes.

You will be working within world class facilities regardless of which site you are based. There may also be opportunities to travel between the Company’s UK sites to meet with colleagues, customers and suppliers.


How this role fits in

Leonardo's four year Electronics Engineering Degree Apprenticeship programme is looking for people who understand the importance of communication, who are able to work well as part of a team and also on their own initiative. You will have the drive and commitment to work through difficult problems to find the right engineering solutions.


Role description


You will study with one of our academic partners for completion of a Level 6 Bachelor Honours Degree (BEng) through a mixture of work based learning and attendance at University. This Apprenticeship aligns with the current edition of the UK Standard for Professional Engineering Competence (UK-SPEC) at Incorporated Engineering (IEng) and Embedded Electronics & System Design standards (ST0151).


We need people who understand the importance of our Customers and are ready to commit to working in the business, whilst also committing to a 4 year degree programme. At the end of the programme, you will work as a highly qualified member of our Electronics Engineering community.

You will be working for a company at the cutting edge of technology, as well as enhancing your skills and business acumen, opening up your horizons to the diverse and dynamic ways to apply your academic learning in a practical environment.

We have created a programme across our UK sites that value those who continuously ask questions and look to resolve problems through creative and innovative thinking.


Who would suit this role?

Leonardo values people that look to always develop throughout their career and along with an eager willingness to learn, a successful apprenticeship with Leonardo involves a drive to deliver results, sometimes from your own initiative, a patience for problem solving, as well as a need to comply with safety instructions and clear process compliance at all times. We view commitment to the programme and learning objectives very highly.


Note: This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has little professional engineering experience and is NOT suitable for candidates who already have an engineering degree.


Salary £23,500


During your Apprenticeship we encourage you to spend at least 3/4 days a week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.


Mandatory

Qualifications

You must have (as a minimum) the following qualifications:

3 x A Levels (A*- C) one of which must be - English, Maths or a technical related subject

OR

An alternative Level 3 qualification, which must be an engineering or ICT related subject

AND

GCSE (Grade 4 - 9 / A*- C) in Maths and English


Security Clearance

At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.

For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.

To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.

title: Regional Regulatory Lead
description:
The Regional Regulatory Lead (RRL) is responsible for both strategic and operational regulatory activities within the assigned Therapeutic Area (TA) for designated products across designated regions or sub-regions: Asia Pacific (APAC), Latin America (LATAM), Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), Adriatics, Middle East & Africa (MEA) and Partner Business. The RPL can be based at either of the following sites: Zurich (Switzerland), or Maidenhead (UK).

Working with the Therapeutic Area Lead and the Global Regulatory Lead, the RRL contributes to global regulatory strategy and manages regional regulatory strategies that align with commercial and business priorities.

This position ensures adherence to regional regulatory requirements and oversees submissions related to marketing applications, life cycle management, tender applications, interactions with Health Authorities, PSURs, and associated reporting responsibilities. The RRL partners with Local Regulatory Representative (LRR), Regulatory Partner Representative (RPR), and other internal stakeholders to facilitate timely Health Authority approvals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the regional regulatory strategist for the assigned product portfolio and countries in alignment with the global strategy and priorities across designated regions or sub-regions: Asia Pacific (APAC), Latin America (LATAM), Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), Adriatics, Middle East & Africa (MEA) and Partner Business.
  • Develop and implement regulatory strategies that meet regional requirements for any regulatory activities, while identifying the most efficient approval pathways by leveraging LRR or RPR local inputs.
  • Contribute to RST activities and support the development of Global Regulatory Strategy, including planning and preparation of projects or response for complex scientific questions that require product expertise and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Lead the strategic oversight of regulatory activities across the assigned product portfolio and countries to drive optimal Health Authority outcomes and proactively anticipate and manage emerging regulatory risks.
  • Provide strategic oversight to ensure high-quality regulatory submission documentation for all regulatory activities, including responses to Health Authority questions, aligned with schedules and regional requirements, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Build and maintain strong collaboration with Local Regulatory Representatives (LRR), Regulatory Partner Representatives (RPR), and other internal stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with regional Health Authorities by delivering high quality, compliant regulatory documentation and engaging with clarity and influence to support positive outcomes for CSL.
  • Stay current with international legislation and guidelines relevant to any CSL products and other key related CSL activities and initiatives (e.g. rare diseases, orphan drugs, toll manufacturing, reliance pathways)
  • Act as a subject matter expert by assessing the impact of local or regional regulation and identifying potential regulatory risks.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvements to enhance regulatory execution, compliance, and operational excellence.

Your Profile

  • A degree in Biological or Medical Science or Pharmacy, preferably with a post-graduate qualification. Degree e.g. in Drug Regulatory Affairs advantageous
  • At least 5 years of regulatory experience within the international markets, supported by additional pharmaceutical /industry experience.
  • English mandatory, and additional language is an asset (e.g. Arabic, French, Spanish, Russian)
  • Understanding of the scientific principles and technical requirements relevant to the development of a pharmaceutical product and understanding of the principles of GMP, GCP.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the delivery of life-changing therapies to patients worldwide while working within a collaborative and innovative global environment.


At CSL, we are committed to continuous improvement, scientific excellence, and making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives.

We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Applications must include a motivation letter and CV.


About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.


CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit and CSL Plasma at .

You Belong at CSL

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. title: Staff Software Engineer - AI II
location: United States of America, Eagan, Minnesota
description:
Job Description


Are you passionate about transforming the future of legal research with AI? Join our Global Westlaw Engineering organization and help shape the next generation of intelligent legal research solutions.


The Global Westlaw Engineering organization builds and operates the technology that powers Westlaw, the world's leading legal research platform. Our teams develop innovative products and AI-driven solutions that help legal professionals find trusted answers, uncover insights, and make confident decisions faster. You will work on cutting-edge technologies including agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI platforms, and large-scale knowledge services, enabling teams across Westlaw to deliver intelligent, trustworthy, and high-performing solutions for legal professionals worldwide.


Key Responsibilities


  • Build and architect AI-driven systems – Design and lead the implementation of enterprise-scale AI systems, including multi-component pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge graph–based architectures, and autonomous AI agents with multi-step reasoning; stay hands-on across the stack, from AI orchestration and RAG through API gateways, microservices, and modern web UIs.
  • Drive innovation and technical strategy – Evaluate and drive adoption of emerging AI techniques; run proof-of-concept work and assess technical feasibility for new AI-driven features; stay current with AI research and translate insights into technical roadmaps; represent the organization at industry conferences and events.
  • Provide senior technical leadership – Make architecture decisions and translate business requirements into scalable technical specifications; mentor senior and junior software engineers; champion MLOps and LLMOps practices and governance for the AI model lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality, security, and operational excellence – Design and implement testing, monitoring, and observability for AI systems at scale; ensure compliance with ethical AI principles, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration and drive business value delivery – Partner with AI researchers, engineering leadership, design, and product to turn AI capabilities into customer-facing applications; set technical priorities and stay engaged through delivery so AI investments produce measurable business value; optimize performance for latency, cost, and user experience; influence product strategy through technical depth.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience (Master’s preferred).
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in senior or lead roles on AI/ML systems.
  • A track record as a software engineer with AI expertise (not primarily a data scientist or researcher), with hands-on experience in generative AI, RAG, or LLM-based systems, covering discovery, architecture, agentic tools, evaluation, deployment, and metrics.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language, with strong backend service and API design skills.
  • Solid understanding of ML principles, evaluation methodologies, and distributed systems, plus working experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Advanced experience with AWS and with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, and a record of integrating AI models into large-scale production systems through APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong technical leadership and mentoring experience as an individual contributor, with the communication skills to influence senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience leading technical direction for teams building agent-based systems or enterprise integrations with AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
  • Advanced knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and information retrieval.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, including graph data modeling, ontologies and taxonomies, graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and combining graphs with LLMs through approaches such as GraphRAG and entity extraction.
  • Domain expertise in legal, tax, accounting, or other regulated industries, or in large-scale search platforms.
  • Successful AI product launches and experience scaling AI systems to enterprise customers.
  • Experience with AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Publications, patents, or speaking experience in AI/ML.

BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit . Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

Position Overview:

As our Manufacturing Development Technologist, you will lead and support fuel development and manufacturing operations by interpreting technical requirements and guiding process execution.

Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

Your Day to Day as a Manufacturing Development Technologist:

  • Serve as a lead operator for fuel development and manufacturing processes, working with high-temperature furnace systems, glovebox operations, and other fuel processing equipment.
  • Support installation, on/off-site testing, and calibration schedules of assigned equipment.
  • Assist with analyzing and resolving development/manufacturing issues.
  • Provide feedback on system behaviors, facility requirements and functionality relative to operations.
  • Serve as an area lead for fuel development/manufacturing operations, ensuring physical and radiological safety for assigned areas.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings and equipment specifications relative to functionality, installation and operation to ensure effective process execution.
  • Mentor and train new operators.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders for area change management efforts including respective area owners, engineering, project controls, environmental health & safety and management.
  • Act as the point of contact for assigned process areas.
  • Support generation and revision of operating and technical procedures for assigned areas.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • A High School diploma/GED is required. An associate’s degree in a related field is preferred and may substitute for experience.
  • A minimum of ten (10) years of related experience is required.
  • Must have extensive experience in fuel handling operations; to include high-temperature furnace and glovebox operations.
  • Must possess demonstrable ability to trouble-shoot and resolve complex process issues.
  • Must be proficient in reading and interpreting engineering drawings.
  • Must be highly self-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.
  • Must be able to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely written and verbal communication.
  • Must possess a strong commitment to safety culture and willingness to ensure compliance with all codes and standards.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A Diploma/Certificate in a related field (such as Machine Technology, Electronics, Materials Science or Chemistry).
  • Prior experience working in a radiological laboratory or chemical handling environment.
  • Familiarity with metallographic operations including sample preparation, imaging and analysis (i.e. digital imaging, microscopy).
  • Prior experience with dimensional inspection techniques and/or familiarity with interpretation of dimensional data – optical comparator and/or CNC machines – is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products and process management software (i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Devonway).
  • Experience with modeling and drafting software (SolidWorks or AutoCAD).
  • Active DOD or DOE security clearance.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.
  • Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.
  • An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.
  • The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

7-Axis CNC HBM Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

We are hiring a 7-Axis CNC Horizontal Boring Mill Operator for our facility in Barberton, Ohio!

The individual hired for this role will operate horizontal boring mills with vertical machining and boring attachments, with continuous path, to perform contouring, trepanning, milling, face milling, drilling, tapping, boring, and other CNC operations necessary for machining large-scale precision components. Additionally, the machinist will:

  • Grind and perform handwork to deburr, as necessary
  • Use electronic measuring probe to inspect work, as required
  • Work from process, drawings, manuscripts, verbal and written instructions
  • Obtain necessary tooling and information for tape or manual data input operations
  • Position and secure work piece and fixtures on table; properly assembles tooling and connects attachments
  • Use precision instruments to physically measure setup; observe digital readout and compensate to orient work piece and machine to tape or MDI
  • Make test cut and rechecks setup; make in-process compensations to keep prints, tapes, and manuscripts coordinated at all times
  • Keep equipment and work area clean and orderly
  • Verify identity and physical characteristics of materials, as required
  • Maintain necessary records and complete process documentation and any production records, as required
  • Perform minor maintenance on machines and assist maintenance personnel as required during repairs

Minimum Requirements:

In order to thrive in this role, individuals must possess the necessary skills to safely perform the required tasks. This includes having a high school diploma or GED equivalence coupled with at least three (3) years of experience performing multi-axis CNC HBM machining operations, with and without continuous path. Lesser experience coupled with formal education and/or certification may be considered. Desired applicants must also:

  • Be knowledgeable of all machine functions and coded commands (both G and M code)
  • Work to 0.000” tolerance and microfinish 16 when necessary
  • Use higher math and engineering theories to work with tooling engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices
  • Have experience with grinders, tool setter, jacks, clamps, bolts, shims, jigs, fixtures, angle plates, rules, micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, lapping equipment, gages, levels, protractors, verniers, and light hand tools
  • Be able to pass all proficiency testing for the position
  • Be a U.S. citizen
  • Must be open and available to working all shifts
  • Successfully pass all pre-employment processes, including an extensive criminal background check, a physical examination and drug screen, verification of education and work history, and reference checks.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required communicate verbally and with written information; to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and use ladders inside and outside of parts being machined. The employee is occasionally required to lift and move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

description:

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Project Manager, New Product Introduction – Advanced Imaging

At Teledyne FLIR’s Integrated Imaging Solutions business, advanced machine vision, stereo and spherical camera technologies support applications across robotics, medical and life sciences, consumer electronics and entertainment.

As Project Manager, you’ll take ownership of complex product development and New Product Introduction (NPI) projects, connecting Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality and Operations. If you enjoy bringing structure to technical challenges and turning product priorities into successful launches, this role offers significant cross-functional impact.


What you’ll do

  • Lead product development and NPI projects through commercialization and production launch.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and resolve resource or execution constraints.
  • Identify risks early and drive clear mitigation, ownership and escalation.

  • Guide projects through PLM processes and required gate criteria.

title: PMO Lead
description:
Req ID: 394778

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a PMO Lead to join our team in Los Angeles, California (US-CA), United States (US).

NTT DATA is seeking a PMO Lead to support the LAUSD AWS Transformation Migration program in Los Angeles, California. This client-facing role requires a highly organized delivery leader with strong technical understanding of AWS cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, application migration planning, security, networking, dependency management, and operational transition. The ideal candidate must have a proven record of success leading complex technology programs, building trust with customer stakeholders, communicating clearly with executives and technical teams, and making sound, timely decisions in high-pressure situations where issues must be assessed quickly and resolved without losing delivery momentum.

This role is based in Los Angeles, California and requires the resource to be in the LAUSD office two to three days per week, with onsite participation in customer meetings, governance sessions, technical workshops, and other program-related activities as required.

In this role you will be responsible for:

  • Lead PMO activities for the LAUSD AWS Transformation Migration program, including governance, integrated planning, workstream coordination, schedule management, risk tracking, issue resolution, and executive status reporting.
  • Coordinate across LAUSD stakeholders, NTT DATA delivery teams, AWS architects, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, operations teams, vendors, and third-party partners to maintain alignment and accountability.
  • Develop and maintain integrated migration plans, dependency logs, RAID logs, decision logs, cutover plans, status dashboards, and executive-ready program materials.
  • Partner with AWS architects and technical leads to track application readiness, infrastructure readiness, security requirements, migration waves, data dependencies, testing plans, cutover activities, and post-migration stabilization.
  • Facilitate program governance meetings, technical working sessions, customer briefings, risk reviews, migration readiness reviews, steering committee preparation, and onsite customer meetings at LAUSD locations as required.
  • Provide confident, fact-based communication when urgent decisions are required, including clearly presenting options, impacts, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended actions.
  • Serve as a customer-facing escalation point for schedule conflicts, technical blockers, dependency gaps, migration risks, and cross-team coordination issues.
  • Drive accountability across matrixed teams while maintaining a professional, calm, transparent, and solution-oriented approach with LAUSD leadership and delivery stakeholders.
  • Support operational transition activities, including runbook readiness, support model alignment, SLA/KPI expectations, knowledge transfer, escalation procedures, and handoff to managed services operations.

Required Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience leading complex technology programs, cloud transformation initiatives, infrastructure modernization efforts, application migrations, or large-scale IT delivery programs, with a proven record of successful outcomes.
  • 5+ years of experience in PMO leadership, program management, delivery governance, or portfolio coordination within matrixed enterprise environments.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • Availability to work onsite at the LAUSD office in Los Angeles, California two to three days per week and participate onsite in customer meetings, workshops, and program governance sessions as required.
  • PMP certification preferred; AWS, Agile, ITIL, infrastructure, cloud, or security-related certifications are strongly preferred.

Preferred Skills and Candidate Attributes:

  • Hands-on technical understanding of AWS cloud migration concepts, including landing zones, networking, identity and access management, security controls, compute, storage, databases, application dependencies, migration waves, testing, and cutover planning.
  • Experience supporting public-sector, education, government, or highly regulated clients where governance, compliance, stakeholder management, and executive communications are critical.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with technical architects, engineers, business stakeholders, customer executives, vendors, and operations teams in a clear and credible manner.
  • Proven ability to make quick, sound decisions under pressure by assessing facts, identifying risks, escalating appropriately, and recommending practical recovery actions.
  • Experience developing executive status reports, migration dashboards, integrated schedules, RAID logs, dependency trackers, action item registers, and formal governance documentation.
  • Strong technical credibility with the ability to understand AWS migration sequencing, application dependencies, infrastructure readiness, security impacts, network constraints, operational support needs, and customer risk considerations.
  • Customer-facing presence with the ability to represent NTT DATA professionally in onsite and remote meetings with LAUSD leadership, technical teams, project stakeholders, and vendor partners.
  • Ability to think quickly, remain calm under pressure, and make practical decisions when faced with urgent issues, conflicting inputs, incomplete information, or time-sensitive migration events.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, negotiation, conflict-resolution, meeting management, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to create structure in ambiguous environments, drive accountability, and maintain disciplined documentation across fast-moving migration workstreams.
  • Comfortable working in a high-pressure delivery environment where customer confidence, AWS migration timelines, technical blockers, security requirements, and vendor coordination must be managed simultaneously.
  • Experience supporting K-12 education, large public-sector clients, or enterprise environments with complex governance, procurement, security, and stakeholder communication requirements is a plus.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

Position Overview:

BWXT Advanced Technologies (AT) is seeking a Computer Vision / Machine Learning R&D Engineer with an interest in applications of computer vision to complex manufacturing processes. Your skills in machine vision, analytics, machine learning, sensors or robotics will support the research and development of a wide range of nuclear products for space applications, clean power, and propulsion.

Location:

This position is based on-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office.

Your Day to Day as a Computer Vision / Machine Learning R&D Engineer:

  • Develop physics informed and constrained machine learning models that are integrated with machine vision classifiers, to identify and classify manufacturing defects and process variation.
  • Work on image classifiers, object detectors, video understanding models, multi-modal classifiers, etc.
  • Work to develop and improve sensor systems and hardware based directly on model performance.
  • Work with engineering teams to implement model pipelines and deploy the services at scale.
  • Collaborate with data analysts to understand and find data patterns.

Required Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, physics, computer science, data science, or a related field is required.
  • A minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience is required.
  • Must have experience in computer vision and machine learning, with a strong focus on deep generative models (e.g., GANs, VAEs, diffusion models).
  • Must have experience in signal processing with demonstrated knowledge and application of signal processing techniques.
  • Must be a self-starter and comfortable supporting multiple teams, systems and developing products.
  • Travel (30-40%) domestic and international is required.
  • Must be a US Citizen.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.
  • Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.
  • An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.
  • The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
In this position....

Ford's connected vehicles send us a constant stream of data: trips, alerts, battery and health signals, and much more. The Connected Vehicle Data Team in GDIA (Global Data Insight & Analytics) builds the services, APIs and applications that make that data easy to find, understand, and use across Ford.
We're looking for an early- to mid-career full-stack software engineer who likes building things end to end: backend services in Java and Spring Boot, frontends in React or Angular, and the cloud deployments and data flows that connect them. You'll deploy to OpenShift and Google Cloud, learn how streaming data behaves at very large scale, and see your work used to spot vehicle issues sooner.
You don't need to have done everything on this page. We care more that you're curious, careful with details, and eager to learn. That's what the Ford OS Behaviors are about: be a builder, play to win, and deliver the promise.

What you’ll do….

  • Backend services and APIs. Build and maintain REST APIs and microservices in Java and Spring Boot, backed by SQL databases and BigQuery.
  • Frontend apps and dashboards. Build features and reusable components in React or Angular with TypeScript that help people explore vehicle data.
  • Streaming integrations. Write Kafka and Pub/Sub producers and consumers, and learn how to handle retries, failed messages, and message order.
  • Cloud deployments. Package apps with Docker and deploy them to OpenShift and GCP (Cloud Run, GKE), including configuration, secrets, and health checks.
  • Testing and quality. Write unit and integration tests with JUnit and frontend test tools (for example, Jest or Cypress), take part in code reviews and pairing, and learn test-driven development.
  • Monitoring and support. Add logging, alerts, and dashboards in Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring, and help troubleshoot production issues using runbooks.
  • Good engineering habits. Use Git and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Tekton), keep dependencies up to date, fix issues found by code quality and security scans, and follow secure coding, API security, and data privacy practices.
  • AI in practice. Use tools like GitHub Copilot every day for code, tests, and documentation. You'll also help with the team's AI work, for example:
    • building the API and UI for an assistant that answers plain-English questions about vehicle data
    • calling LLM APIs to draft metadata, summaries, or release notes
    • trying simple ways for an AI assistant to answer questions from team documentation
    • writing test cases that check AI output is accurate and safe
  • Working as a team. Work with senior engineers, the team's technical lead (Anchor), product owners, data engineers, and platform teams to plan work in small pieces and ship them. data engineers, and platform teams to plan work in small pieces and ship them.

You’ll have…

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 1 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong internships or co-ops count.
  • Hands-on experience building backend services or REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Day-to-day use of Git, and experience writing automated tests (for example, JUnit).
  • A basic understanding of Docker and deploying applications to a cloud or container platform.
  • The habit of asking "how will I know this works?" and testing before you ship.

Even better, you may have….

  • GCP experience, especially Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, or Cloud Storage.
  • Kafka or Pub/Sub, or concepts such as retries, dead-letter queues, and message ordering.
  • OpenShift or Kubernetes (deployments, config maps, secrets, health checks).
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Tekton, or Jenkins, code scanning tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, or FOSSA, and some Terraform.
  • Monitoring with Cloud Monitoring, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Splunk, and setting reliability targets (SLOs).
  • Agile practices such as Scrum, XP, test-driven development, or pair programming.
  • Hands-on work with AI, such as calling an LLM API, building a small RAG app, or an agent. School, hackathon, and personal projects all count.
  • Python for scripting or data work.
  • Experience with IoT, telemetry, or other time-series data.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance
• Established and active employee resource groups
• Paid time off for individual and team community service
• A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

title: 1st Shift Mobile Power Team Lead
description:
Work Model: This is a fully onsite role, with work performed at your designated Regal Rexnord office.

____________________

SUMMARY

The purpose of the SHIFT Team Leader role is to provide guidance and support on an ongoing basis to production associates in the Mobile Power Value Stream. The success of the person in this role is vital to the continuous improvement efforts in the area(s), as well as the success of Warner Electric to meet and exceed customer expectations. This is a “working leader” where 40% of their time is spent operating within a team-based manufacturing cell

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty above standard expectations, as well as maintain a status as ‘certified’ trainer in the area. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • May attend designated external course on supervision/leadership as determined by management and then at least on a once annual basis.
  • May be required to spend limited time on an alternate shift(s) for training and understanding of daily priorities.
  • Ensure the work area and associates assigned to work area maintain the appropriate level of 5S at all times and the Daily Management boards are updated on a regular basis.
  • Coordinate with Supervisors to ensure a safe working environment exists at all times. Retraining associates when necessary to ensure appropriate safety behavior is established, understood and recognized. All safety concerns should be brought to Supervision immediately.
  • Will assume lead role for their area/shift in addressing any quality concerns or defects that may develop throughout the shift. May conduct training sessions with the associates to raise awareness and resolve quality issues.
  • Champions standard work methodology. Ensures consistent standard work is followed on a consistent method. Identifies and problem-solves when it is not.
  • May assist and govern the training of all new associates to ensure consistency and transferred understanding. Training will include, but is not limited to appropriate methods of standard work and rotation, changeover and setup of machines, maintaining and operating machines, understanding daily priorities (including safety start-up check sheets, first piece process, audit and end of shift line stock/clean up), ensuring the correct procedures are followed to produce quality parts, completing the necessary paperwork throughout the shift, training and clarifying company policies and procedures, and updating Daily Management boards daily.
  • Will lead by example and provide coaching to all associates as needed to ensure all policies and procedures are followed during the shift. Examples include but are not limited to: safe work practices, time management (‘buzzer to buzzer’ work performance), adherence to the plant work rules, and quality processes. If the coaching does not prove to be effective, the Team Leader will notify the Supervisor for additional guidance and support.
  • Open to cross-training on multiple Teams/part numbers, recognizing ongoing cross-training is not limited to his assigned value stream area.
  • Will act a primary ‘coordinator’ with Quality, Engineering, and Maintenance to identify areas for improvement and solving issue as they arise.
  • Maintain an open line of communication with fellow associates to communicate concerns or ideas to Supervision in a timely manner. Included are issues regarding personnel, safety, quality, delivery, productivity, or general concerns relating to the assigned area. Meetings with supervision should be scheduled as needed to address any concerns.
  • Interface with the previous shift Team Leader(s) as well as the following Team Leader(s) to pass on relevant information.
  • Subject to standard overtime scheduling and rotation.
  • Other duties as required.

ESSENTIAL PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

Common sense

Detail-oriented

Ability to prioritize

Exceptional integrity

High degree of professionalism

Creative

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Lead by example

Positive role model

Area expert

Team player

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE CREDENTIALS

High School Diploma or GED required. Must be considered current ‘expert’ in the area and considered a “Champion of Lean.” Previous experience required. Post-secondary education preferred.

Key Performance Metrics

Safety

Product quality

On-time delivery

Productivity

LANGUAGE SKILLS

The ability to read and interpret documents such as general business periodicals, safety rules, quality instruction and process documentation, operating and maintenance instructions, technical and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports, operating instructions, procedure manuals, and business correspondences. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of employees and managers, customers, clients and the general public.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS and WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and to stand 100% of the day. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision and peripheral vision.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually minimal to moderate.
