About Lamb Weston


You’ve probably enjoyed our fries without even knowing it! As a leading manufacturer in our industry, we inspire and bring people together with foods they love and trust. Our customer base includes international food service providers, restaurants, and households in over 100 countries around the world.


A highly innovative global corporation with a start-up mindset, we empower every individual to make a genuine difference. You’ll gain access to hands-on training to fuel your growth and success, explore opportunities for new solutions, and you’ll join a winning team of 10,000+ people all dedicated to raising the bar – together.


If you have a strong drive for results, a desire to help us bring the world together through our fries, and are ready for a fresh challenge, we want to hear from you.

Job Description Summary

The HRIS team is responsible for owning and managing Workday, supporting multiple business functions within the global business units at Lamb Weston. This team works closely with our stakeholders across HR, Process Innovation, Payroll, Performance, Compensation, Learning, Recruiting and Benefits, etc. to provide technology solutions and services to enable them for success in carrying out business operations & launching strategic business projects.



As a Senior HRIS Analyst you will be responsible for working in collaboration with global business stakeholders to drive and implement projects to meet the business goals and objectives of Lamb Weston. You will be the acting subject matter expert (SME) on assigned Workday modules (HCM, Core & Advanced Compensation) while having a working knowledge of other modules, and processes to engage and partner with leaders to architect solutions and implement them. You will be responsible for defining standards and best practices for Workday, both in implementation of configuration and support. You will act as a Workday champion and stay on top of Workday’s releases and features to implement the latest and greatest for your business stakeholders.

Job Description


  • This role will require thorough knowledge and understanding of core HR business processes, practices, and experience implementing and administering Workday for large enterprise companies. This role reports to the Manager of HR Systems.
  • Manage annual Global Advanced Compensation Process.
  • Participate in discovery sessions with business stakeholders and cross functional teams to analyze business requirements and translate into documented solutions.
  • Develop scalable solutions on the Workday platform for the Global HR teams for best-in-class user experience, performance and security.
  • Work closely with business to explore opportunities to leverage Workday functionalities and features to improve HR business processes and operations.
  • Provide technical leadership in analyzing system requirements, overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT), and ensuring successful execution of system upgrades and enhancements.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, user guides, and training materials to support system changes and ensure effective knowledge transfer.
  • Challenge existing business & IT processes, methods and systems for improving operations, security and scalability.
  • Uphold the highest standards of application security and data integrity on the Workday platform and protect sensitive HR data and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
  • Participate in weekly resourcing updates and manage communications with business stakeholders, ensuring reliable project tracking, execution, and on time deliverables.
  • Support the reporting needs of business to design and develop insightful analytics solutions on the Workday platform. Skills to include extensive calculated fields, advanced report types, dashboards and Hubs.
  • Ability to understand the impacts of any changes to Workday processes and configuration on other technologies and on downstream systems ensuring the appropriate parties are advised.
  • Build reports and dashboards to drive self-service and to support reporting.
  • Stay abreast of the latest Workday releases to promote awareness, and adoption of Workday tools to drive more productivity and efficiency within HR operations.
  • Proactively share knowledge with HR Service Center support teams including assisting in the development of documentation, guidelines, end-user training resources and other materials as required.
  • Partner with team members through project collaboration and KT’s:
  • Gather, build and test requirements for multiple modules within Workday HCM, Payroll, Time Tracking, Absence, Benefits, Talent, Learning, Performance, Talent, Compensation and Recruiting as assigned.
  • Provides system mass update support via EIBs for all functional areas of Workday.
  • Collaborate with HRIS team members to support all escalated HRIS related Workday support tickets via Service Now within established service level agreement.
  • Provides support and collaborates on all integrations including the management of current integrations.
  • Effectively define, configure and document technical requirements for system configurations and enhancements.
  • Configure Annual Compensation Statements in Workday Documents and other documents as needed.
  • Lead the bi-annual Workday release management process for assigned modules to include analysis of updates, creation of testing scenarios and configuration validation.
  • Perform thorough review of business requirements to determine feasibility of the request, provide additional functional solutions and work with stakeholders to deliver the requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Basic & Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education/training/experience in Management Information Systems, Human Resources, or related field required.
  • Workday Certification is preferred
  • A minimum of five (5) years of Workday experience with three (3) years specific to the assigned Workday module (Compensation).
  • PROFICIENCY_RATING_ADVANCED experience with the building and maintenance of calculated fields is strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical and working knowledge of HR systems, applications, theory and practice.
  • PROFICIENCY_RATING_ADVANCED proficiency with data conversion and mapping.
  • Ability to provide, in user-friendly terms, sound ideas and solutions to end users on HR systems-related questions, tasks, projects and reports.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of business objectives both internally and externally which impact the company’s ability to achieve its objectives.

Industry-Competitive Benefits

Coupled with our compensation and bonus incentive programs, our benefits deliver rewards that are market competitive. Some of the most attractive elements of our benefit programs include:

  • Health Insurance Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Health and Dependent Care, and Health Reimbursement Accounts

  • Well-being programs including companywide events and a wellness incentive program

  • Paid Time Off

  • Financial Wellness – Industry leading 401(k) plan with generous company contributions, Financial Planning Services, Employee Stock purchase program, and Health Savings Accounts, Life and Accident insurance

  • Family-Friendly Employee events

  • Employee Assistance Program services – mental health and other concierge type services

We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting-edge and next-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.



FMC Corporation is a leading specialty company focused on agricultural technologies. FMC provides innovative and cost-effective solutions to enhance crop yield and quality by controlling a broad spectrum of insects, weeds and disease, as well as in non-agricultural markets for pest control.


FMC is a globally diverse organization that offers its employees exciting opportunities to work on challenging projects that are important to the achievement of our strategic objectives. Your education and professional experience are valued and put to use from day one. Your success at completing key initiatives can result in a varied, progressive and fulfilling career with FMC.


With a corporate culture of innovation, integrity, responsibility and customer intimacy, we foster “The Right Chemistry” in everything we do. We are looking for people to join us in creating, developing, and improving our products, our processes, and our markets. If you are ready to make a difference every day, FMC is ready to talk to you.


Business/Function Overview:

The Facility Contractor Administrator (FCA) is responsible for managing the interface between the contractors and the area(s). FCA is the primary liaison between the contractors and plant management.

FCA is accountable for ensuring safe, consistent, reliable operations by providing leadership, managing process and personal safety, environmental compliance, meeting product quality specifications and achieving plant performance objectives. This position will report to EHS Manager and receive Functional directions from Maintenance Manager.

FCA is a full-time position with an expectation of 50-75% of their time spent in the field. FCA will support EHS, Operations and Maintenance daily operations as needed.


The Facility Supervisor is responsible in the following (but not limited) areas:

• Ensure 100% compliance of EHS requirements including PPE use, incident reporting, safe completion of life critical activities within department, process safety, food safety and quality standards

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and FMC safety requirements

• Monitor safety, quality, cost, and schedule

• Prepare passes and work permits

• Acceptance of services or work completed and verify receipt of service

• Monitor and document changes to contract

• Audit contractor's safety program and performance

• Develop or revise working practices and procedures to ensure compliance with standards

• Provide input on post-job evaluation

• Support EHS, Operation and Maintenance jobs and activities when needed

• Assist with and lead changes through management of change process

• Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve production and maintenance issues

-Teamwork/Collaboration - Managing For Productivity - Innovation Engagement - Embracing Change - Communicating With Impact - Business Acumen - Build Sustainable Customer Relationships - Analysis and Judgment

This is a winter / spring co-op opportunity in Norwood, MA from January 18, 2027 – June 25, 2027. Applicants must be available for the entire duration of the co-op. Start date will be January 18, 2027.


The Co-Op, Biopharmaceutical Manufacturing Operations will be on the DNA Specialist team at Moderna and support DNA manufacturing operations by enabling reliable, compliant execution through strong documentation practices and continuous improvement. As a Co-Op, you will learn how documentation is created, updated, and governed in a regulated (GxP) manufacturing environment, and you will support process improvement and continuous improvement initiatives that help strengthen safety, quality, and operational performance at the Norwood site. This role is designed to provide hands-on experience with documentation workflows, cross-functional collaboration, and structured problem-solving in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.


Here’s What You’ll Do

Job Description

The Technical Accessibility Specialist interfaces with UX, designers, product managers, business leaders, internal clients, developers, and students to deliver accessible experiences to our public, employee, and student-facing products. Innovation, design, and functionality are key components to the success of this role. The specialist’s role is also to partner to create solutions that solve problems while advancing accessibility and inclusion that fits into the university’s brand and ultimately leads to student success.

Job Duties Runs audits and accessibility tests on the university’s platforms and products for conformance with the current version of WCAG. Has expertise in using screen readers and other assistive technologies such as JAWS, Dragon, & NVDA (Non-Visual Desktop Access). Creates a remediation plan for university platforms and products. Prepares evaluation documentation for communication with university stakeholders and product teams. Provides expert accessibility guidance to designers, product managers, developers, and business partners to influence product development. Maintains knowledge of accessibility industry trends, innovations, and solutions, as well as accessibility-related standards, laws, and management strategies. Develops guidelines for architects, designers, and developers to aid in compliance with the current version of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG). Trains/coaches colleagues one-on-one and in small group environments on ADA awareness, implementing solutions and fostering innovation through accessibility. Consults with colleagues to solve challenging accessibility barriers. Develops and documents team processes and procedures regarding accessibility. Assists with the research, development, and maintenance of the accessibility evaluation methodology. Assists with the training and mentoring of new team members. Networks with accessibility industry professionals. Performs other job-related duties as assigned. KSAs Broad knowledge of WCAG, Section 508, and ADA. Ability to read and interpret HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and explain accessibility best practices Ability to confidently navigate multiple environments in one screen reader and understand how a screen reader interacts with user agent elements. Understands how various types of disabilities experience digital environments and how to design accessible digital spaces. Ability to accurately collect data and analyze it to identify areas of process and performance improvement. Ability to understand and explain technical and user experience issues in simple and concise language. Ability to research complex topics and find answers to questions independently. Ability to work on team projects under the direction of senior team members. Ability to study and comprehend complex technical documentation (WCAG 2.x AA, Section 508). Self-initiative and self-motivation. Ability to self-manage daily tasks and meet deadlines. Ability to work independently without supervision, and as part of a team. Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects at a time. Generally, equivalent relevant experience is defined as 1 year of experience for 1 year of education and is the discretion of the hiring manager. The Front Line Manager II – Machining & Assembly is responsible for leading multiple skilled trades teams across machining, assembly, and associated precision‑fabrication operations within the Barberton facility. This higher‑tier leadership role carries expanded ownership for cross‑shift coordination, production planning, workflow prioritization, and technical problem‑solving within a complex, multi‑building machining environment.

The FLM II ensures safe, high‑quality, and efficient execution of machining and assembly work scopes, proactively resolves technical and operational challenges, and drives continuous improvement across processes, procedures, technology usage, and workforce effectiveness. This role serves as a key advocate for employee engagement, communication, and accountability while maintaining strong partnerships with technical support groups.

Location:

On-site in Barberton, Ohio

Operational Leadership & Team Management

  • Supervise, mentor, and develop union hourly skilled trades employees in machining, assembly, and related precision‑fabrication processes.
  • Manage the daily activities of multiple machining and assembly teams, ensuring alignment with safety, quality, and production requirements.
  • Provide leadership continuity across shifts by establishing production plans, coordinating work execution, and ensuring downstream teams are prepared for follow‑through.

  • Plan, direct, and coordinate machining and assembly activities across multiple buildings, work centers, and product lines.

  • Manage complex component flows, ensuring clarity, communication, and coordination of technical requirements, engineering changes, and precision machining tolerances.

  • Apply technical knowledge of machining, assembly, and skilled trade practices to diagnose and resolve manufacturing issues.
  • Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing support, and quality groups to investigate problems, identify root causes, and formalize corrective actions.
  • Communicate safety, quality, and production updates verbally and in writing, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams.

Data Management & Systems Use

  • Input, analyze, and manage data related to labor time, production schedules, and workflow management within applicable computer systems.
  • Utilize established processes, production data, and technology to make autonomous operational decisions and solve problems with limited precedent.

Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

  • Evaluate machining and assembly operations to recommend improvements in workflow design, efficiency, resource utilization, safety, and cost control.
  • Support the implementation of new equipment, technologies, and updated standards across machining and assembly teams.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen workforce engagement, skill development, and cross‑functional collaboration.

Flexibility & Availability

  • Flex between shifts and work areas based on project needs, staffing requirements, or emergent operations.
  • Work scheduled overtime as required to maintain production continuity and meet customer commitments.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

title: Welding Engineer Intern
description:
At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. Headquartered in Lynchburg, Va., BWXT provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for national security, clean energy, environmental remediation, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With approximately 7,400 employees, BWXT has 12 major operating sites in the U.S. and Canada. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental remediation and nuclear operations management at more than a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. Follow us on Twitter at @BWXTech and learn more at .

BWXT is currently seeking a Welding Engineering Intern for its Barberton, Ohio facility.

We are looking for motivated college students to join our highly-skilled team of engineers for an exciting summer internship in Barberton, Ohio.

At BWXT, our interns perform challenging tasks in their field of study while developing and delivering unique solutions for use in a nuclear environment. Our interns work collaboratively as part of our manufacturing and operational teams and will tackle various projects and tasks relating directly to fabrication and engineering challenges. Interns will be exposed to various parts of the manufacturing process that may include process and procedure creation/revisions, assisting with product and/or tooling improvements, perform testing and analysis, and assist with engineering and shop operations personnel on a daily basis. A BWXT internship not only provides valuable on the job training but allows you to be a part of something bigger!

BWXT offers paid internships along with a housing stipend for those interns whose home of record is more than 50 miles from Barberton, OH. Internships will last approximately 10-12 weeks. At the end of the internship, each intern has the opportunity to present their completed work/ assigned projects to the leadership team.

Primary Responsibilities:

The Welding Engineering Intern’s main assignment will be to support welding engineering projects, improvements, and welding engineering specific functions. The intern will support the Welding Engineering Team with various tasks including but not limited to:

  • Learn and carryout basic functions of shop floor and contract welding engineering duties
  • Lead 5S/process improvement projects relating to specific shop operation jobs
  • Assist with performance of welding procedure development and interpretations
  • Perform welding operation and system audits
  • Apply knowledge of welding processes to support shop floor operations and troubleshooting of welding equipment and operations
  • Documentation and support of operational improvements such as the following:
    • Creation of job specific aids, weld instructions, or checklists
    • Carryout operational efficiency projects (Individual & Team Based (Multi-discipline)
    • Support data collection and analysis for weld metrics

Internship Program Qualifications:

  • Must be enrolled full time in an accredited university/college in Welding Engineering, Welding Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Engineering Technology with a welding emphasis, or equivalent with a minimum of 2 years of relevant course work completed.
  • Prior internship experience is preferred but not required
  • Experience or knowledge with basic arc welding processes such as GTAW, SMAW, SAW, and GMAW welding. Robotics/Automated process knowledge is preferred but not required.
  • Proficient in fundamental computer skills (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
  • Strong technical problem-solving abilities and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent technical writing and verbal communication skills
  • Must be a U.S. citizen with no dual citizenship

As a federal government contractor, BWX Technologies, Inc. and any subsidiaries, affiliates and related entities (“BWXT” or the “Company”) complies with all federal, state, and local laws and customer requirements regarding COVID-19 and other health and safety protocols. As such, all BWXT new hires will be required to adhere to applicable Company COVID-19 requirements within the workplace as a condition of employment.

Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Position requires U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance which involves an extensive criminal and financial background investigation and previous employment reference verifications.

title: Senior Consultant, Customer Performance
description:
Senior Consultant, Customer Performance

The Customer Strategy and Enablement team plays a key role in enabling Customer-Centric Growth (CCG) and CTC’s continued evolution toward becoming a more customer-focused organization. The team leads performance measurement, insight development, and customer storylines that assess progress against customer priorities and identify actionable opportunities for improvement.

The Senior Consultant, Customer Performance will deliver insights, performance measurement, and strategic analysis to support customer-focused business decisions. This role partners with cross-functional teams to evaluate customer, loyalty, brand, market, and commercial performance; identify risks and growth opportunities; and translate data into clear, executive-ready recommendations.

What you will do:

Performance Measurement & Customer Storytelling

  • Develop and maintain monthly and quarterly customer performance scorecards, dashboards, and KPI reporting for senior leadership forums with a high degree of accuracy and timely delivery.
  • Build clear customer performance narratives that synthesize KPI results, customer trends, key drivers, risks, opportunities, and business implications.
  • Monitor customer acquisition, retention, engagement, loyalty, and related performance metrics.
  • Track progress against strategic objectives and connect customer insights to broader CTC, BU, loyalty, customer experience, and commercial priorities.

Insights & Analytics

  • Analyze customer, market, competitive, loyalty, brand, and business performance data to uncover actionable insights.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to explain performance drivers, root causes, and business outcomes.
  • Translate complex findings into concise, executive-level recommendations that support planning and decision-making.
  • Monitor competitive benchmarks, industry trends, and emerging measurement approaches to improve insight delivery.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with Decision Support, Analytics, Loyalty, Marketing, Customer Experience, Merchandising, and other business functions.
  • Work with cross-functional partners to assess performance movement and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Present insights and recommendations to senior leaders and business stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on customer performance, measurement, and insight interpretation.

Strategic Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the evolution of customer performance routines, including scorecards, dashboards, templates, timelines, governance processes, and leadership forums.
  • Contribute to annual and multi-year customer experience and engagement target-setting through metric definition, baseline analysis, tracking, and strategic alignment.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of marketing, loyalty, and customer experience programs.
  • Improve reporting processes, measurement frameworks, analytical methodologies, and insight-sharing formats.
  • Leverage approved corporate tools, including Copilot, to improve efficiency, reporting automation, and data accessibility.

What you bring

  • University or college degree, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in business analytics, customer insights, loyalty data, CX strategy, performance measurement, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize large datasets into clear business stories.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Understanding of financial performance, commercial analytics, or business performance measurement is an asset.
  • Experience with process development, reporting routines, and timeline management.
  • Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SQL, or other analytical and reporting tools, including application of AI functionalities for relevant work areas.

We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:

  • Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
  • Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
  • Other perks to support your well-being

About Us


Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most admired and trusted companies. With more than 90 Owned Brands, over 1,600 retail locations, financial services, exemplary e-commerce capabilities, and exciting market-leading merchandising strategies. We dream big and work as one to innovate with purpose for our customers at every level of our business, investing in new technologies and products, and doubling down on top talent to drive the company forward. Join us in helping to make life in Canada better through living and working our Core Values: we are innovators and entrepreneurs at our core, outcomes drive us, inclusion is a must, we are stronger together and we take personal responsibility. title: Senior Director, eCommerce and Customer Fulfillment Technologies
description:
ABOUT SLATE

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

About the Role

This role owns slate.auto as a place to buy. That covers the top of the vehicle purchase funnel, the accessories and wraps Marketplace, and the technology behind fulfillment and service: customer service for owners, service network and partner network support, warranty, returns, and the systems corporate functions rely on. A Slate Truck is designed to change many times over its life, so the GM is also accountable for keeping owners engaged long after delivery.

Three things matter most: product taste, customer engagement, and strong analytical skill. The role works closely with software engineering, the accessories and wraps team, commercial, supply chain, transportation and logistics, the service and partner networks, customer care, finance, and legal.


What You Will Do


Steward the slate.auto buying experience. Set the standard for product content, merchandising, pricing display, availability and delivery messaging, payments, checkout, and site performance. Find where the experience breaks and get it fixed.


Own the top of the vehicle purchase funnel. Guide customers from first visit through product discovery, configurator build, Starter Pack or blank build, payment estimate, and preorder. Measure conversion and drop-off at each stage, present accessories, wraps, and pre-delivery installation where they help the customer decide, and hand off cleanly to the teams that own purchase and delivery.


Lead product management for the storefront. Own the roadmap for vehicle discovery and configuration, the Marketplace, configurator, cart and checkout, and owner account. Write requirements, set priorities with digital engineering and design, and measure each release against a defined outcome. Make fitment reliable so owners know what works with their configuration and what they already have installed.


Keep owners engaged through lifetime of product. Build engagement and enthusiasm for renewing a Slate vehicle many times over its life, including new product drops, collaborations, wrap changes, and SUV Kit conversions. Measure customer engagement and satisfaction, repeat purchase rate, time between purchases, and lifetime value.


Build customer service and reverse logistics product: We easy, elegant yet policy compliant self-service workflows – so Customers can resolve their issues with minimal friction. This includes agent tools that interact directly with customers. For the service network and partner network: self service support tools and case handling for service providers, authorized installation partners, and other partners, including scheduling, parts and accessory orders, and escalation to Slate.


Run the end-to-end order experience. Work with the accessories and wraps team and accessory engineering on launch readiness and fitment, supply chain on forecasts and inventory, logistics on delivery promises and freight for large items such as the SUV Kit, and installation partners on scheduling and quality. When a handoff breaks, the GM owns the fix and the customer communication.


Drive an eCommerce Marketplace success for accessories and wraps. Partners closely with that accessories and wraps product team and optimizes the purchase funnel for on slate.auto: funnel conversion, merchandising, product presentation, attach rate at vehicle purchase, and repeat purchase after delivery. Approach it with a P&L view, tracking revenue, margin, and the cost to sell and fulfill, and share demand signals (configurator saves, abandoned carts, site search, return reasons) to inform the accessories and wraps team's roadmap. Think about both sides of the Marketplace – buyers as well as 3rd party independent marketplace.


Build the team. Hire and lead product management and analytics. Partner with software engineering to bring modern GenAI software development practices to the business and scale it with technology rather than headcount.


Build GenAI products for corporate functions. Work with a small group of forward deployed engineers to build tools that let corporate functions, including finance, legal, HR, and commercial, scale with technology. This should lead to leaping improvements in SG&A costs compared to the rest of the industry – not just incremental improvements.

What Matters Most


Product taste. You can tell a good buying experience from a mediocre one and explain why. You care about the details of a product page, a checkout step, or an agent screen, and you raise the quality of what the team ships.


Customer engagement. You spend time with customers and with the people who support them. You have built programs that brought customers back, and you treat the customer view as an input to every decision.


Highly analytical. You work directly in the data: SQL, funnel and cohort analysis, experiment design, and LTV and demand modeling. You decide from evidence and can explain the decision to people who do not read dashboards.


Required Qualifications


  • 12+ years of GM experience, with deep experience in eCommerce, digital product, or consumer retail, including leadership of a consumer eCommerce site.
  • Ownership of top-of-funnel conversion for a consumer site, from first visit through lead capture, reservation, or order, with measurable gains.
  • Product management leadership across customer-facing and internal products, such as customer or partner service, warranty, returns, or order and finance systems.
  • A track record of lifecycle, CRM, or loyalty programs that increased repeat purchase.
  • Strong quantitative skills, including SQL, funnel and cohort analysis, and experiment design.
  • Experience with physical goods where inventory, fulfillment, and logistics shape the customer experience.
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams, including managing managers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct-to-consumer vehicle sales, online vehicle retail, or preorder programs.
  • Automotive, aftermarket, powersports, or outdoor and recreation categories.
  • Product configurators, fitment data, or installation and service networks.
  • Warranty, returns, or dealer and service network systems.
  • MBA or other advanced degree.

First-Year Outcomes

  • Deliver a delightful customer experience at the launch of slate.auto site.
  • The top of the vehicle purchase funnel mapped and instrumented from first visit through preorder, with an improvement roadmap in place.
  • A defined standard for the slate.auto buying experience, covering product content, delivery messaging, and checkout.
  • A product roadmap for customer and partner service, warranty, returns, and GenAI tools for corporate functions, agreed with customer care, service operations, and corporate function leaders.
  • A lifecycle program live for delivered owners, with repeat purchase measured by cohort.

Work Authorization Requirement:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time.

SALARY RANGE

The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors.


Annual Base Pay Range: 222,431.00 - 370,719.00 USD


ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs.



WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?

At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.

  • Safety First

  • Delight Customers

  • One Team

  • Relentless Improvement

  • Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy

  • Respectful Collaboration

  • Positive Legacy

WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.

Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

title: Senior Customer Complaints Specialist
description:
Excited to grow your career?

BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.

As the legal department responsible for the retail business in Germany, we provide comprehensive legal support for the retail operations of our branch. We are currently a team of five and work closely together in a spirit of trust and collaboration. We see ourselves as a pragmatic, solution-oriented partner to the business.

We value an open, supportive and performance-driven working environment, as well as open communication on an equal footing and genuine teamwork. We place great importance on high professional standards, mutual support and enjoying our work together.

About the job:

Are you experienced in professional complaint management, confident in handling complex customer cases, and passionate about improving processes? Then we would love to hear from you!


For our Digital Banking team at BBVA Germany, we are looking for an experienced professional to support our complaint management operations, coordinate collaboration with our team in Málaga, and actively drive process improvements. The role is part of our Legal Department and combines hands-on complaint handling, operational coordination, and process improvement – without direct people management responsibilities.


Your Responsibilities


● Complaint Management: Independently handle complex customer complaints, develop customer-focused solutions, and collaborate with our Legal team on cases involving legal considerations.

● Operational Coordination: Act as the main point of contact for our outsourced complaint management team in Spain, coordinate day-to-day operations, and ensure high-quality complaint handling.

● Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement, develop solutions, and optimize workflows, quality standards, and escalation procedures.

● Quality & Reporting: Analyze recurring complaint drivers, identify trends, and

prepare relevant reports and insights.


What You Bring


● Several years of solid experience in professional complaint management or customer service, particularly in handling complex or escalated customer cases. Experience in banking or financial services is a plus, but not required.

● Experience coordinating operational teams or external service providers, as well asimproving processes and workflows.

● A confident, professional presence and the ability to influence stakeholders and drive results without formal leadership authority.

● A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach, combined with strong communication skills.

● Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is essential. Spanish language skills are a plus.


What matters most to us is your expertise in complaint management – not the industry you come from. We will help you develop the banking-specific knowledge you need to succeed in this role.


What You Can Expect


A varied specialist role offering ownership, room to make an impact, and international collaboration. You will have the opportunity to contribute your expertise, actively improve processes, and work closely with our teams in Germany and Spain to further develop our complaint management operations.

Customer Targeting, Empathy, Ethics, Innovation, Proactive Thinking

title: Platform Engineering Architect
description:
At Ford, we are the movers of the world and the makers of the future. We get up every day, roll up our sleeves, and build a better world—together. At Ford, we’re all part of something bigger than ourselves. Are you ready to help change the way the world moves?

Do you believe modern, secure, and scalable platforms can help teams build and deliver better software? Ford’s Marketing and Sales Technology organization depends on reliable cloud infrastructure, streamlined developer experiences, and strong platform engineering to support its eCommerce foundation. That’s where this role makes an impact.

We are seeking an experienced Platform Engineering Architect to shape the architecture and evolution of Ford’s next-generation platforms. In this individual-contributor role, you will help own and manage the architecture of Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and Agentic Developer Platforms (ADPs), including self-service capabilities for CI/CD automation, infrastructure provisioning, and platform orchestration.

This role combines hands-on cloud and platform engineering with architecture leadership, DevSecOps, automation, and technical mentorship. You will partner with product teams, senior leaders, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, security, SRE, and other technical domains to translate business and developer needs into secure, scalable, and highly available platform capabilities.

Platform Engineering Strategy & Architecture

  • Own and manage the architecture of Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and Agentic Developer Platforms (ADPs), including self-service capabilities for CI/CD automation, infrastructure provisioning, and platform orchestration.
  • Define and evolve the infrastructure architecture for next-generation platforms, researching current and emerging technologies and recommending solutions for future workload needs.
  • Evaluate and select technologies and tools that support product development and deployment on the eCommerce foundation layer.
  • Partner with product teams to understand developer pain points and improve the Developer Experience through platform engineering capabilities.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical and non-functional specifications.
  • Work with senior leaders across Ford’s Enterprise Architecture and IT Operations organizations to deliver measurable improvements to the eCommerce platform.
  • Champion platform engineering and observability practices across the organization.

Cloud Infrastructure, Automation & DevSecOps

  • Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure platforms using modern DevSecOps and platform engineering practices.
  • Provision and automate Google Cloud infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, gateways, security groups, managed services, and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform, Packer, Ansible, shell scripting, NX Cloud, Helm, and Argo CD.
  • Conduct Infrastructure as Code reviews and automate the deployment of cloud infrastructure.
  • Build repeatable automation for DevSecOps tasks and improve software engineer productivity through integrated CI/CD and infrastructure provisioning services.
  • Establish and apply best practices for code quality, security, performance, and scalability using tools such as SonarQube, Cycode, 42Crunch, Astra, build-time container vulnerability scanning, and FOSSA.
  • Apply patch management, security controls, and operational practices that support platform reliability and maintainability.

Developer Platforms, Cloud-Native Systems & AI

  • Develop and maintain self-service platform products for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud services, and observability.
  • Apply cloud-native architectures and technologies, including microservices, micro frontends, APIs, serverless, Kubernetes, and Docker.
  • Support architectures and services using Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Operations suite, Anthos, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Scheduler, Bigtable, AlloyDB, and other managed services.
  • Implement and monitor AI agents that automate platform engineering services, improve developer productivity, and support platform operations.
  • Support Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agentic AI capabilities for platform engineering.
  • Apply AI Operations (AIOps) practices to improve platform automation and Developer Experience.
  • Advance Shift Left practices for quality, security, and open-source software use, alongside Shift Right platform engineering practices.

Reliability, Performance & Observability

  • Design and apply auto-scaling, high availability, disaster recovery, and multi-region Active/Active and Active/Passive patterns.
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, design documents, and operational procedures for high availability and disaster recovery.
  • Use observability and application performance tools—including Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Splunk—to monitor platform health and support incident diagnosis.
  • Analyze kernel logs, network statistics, application logs, and APM metrics to troubleshoot CPU, memory, and resource hotspots, API latency, and platform-health issues.
  • Identify root causes and resolve complex performance problems involving multiple teams, networks, and software across GCP, Azure, or AWS environments.
  • Identify infrastructure-layer vulnerabilities and performance bottlenecks and recommend solutions to improve subsystem quality and performance.
  • Apply Cloud FinOps practices to understand and optimize cloud infrastructure consumption costs.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentor engineers, helping technical team members grow and succeed.
  • Partner with cloud, security, SRE, release management, and other technical domain experts to deliver secure and reliable platform capabilities.
  • Facilitate technical discussions among diverse stakeholders and help teams reach decisions or recommendations.
  • Communicate architecture decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical teams and executive leaders.
  • Work effectively with global teams in remote and virtual environments and help lead teams through technical and organizational change.

We recognize that no one person will embody every quality or skill listed below. If you bring deep platform engineering expertise and are motivated to improve cloud platforms and developer experiences, we encourage you to apply.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline—or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Preferred degree: Bachelor of Engineering.

Experience

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining self-service platform products for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud services, and observability.
  • Experience with cloud-native systems, platform engineering, DevSecOps, and public cloud environments, particularly Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience building scalable, reliable, and highly available solutions, including containerized and multi-tenant systems.
  • Experience with performance testing, platform monitoring, and troubleshooting complex infrastructure and application issues.
  • Experience deploying, evaluating, and monitoring AI agents for platform engineering automation.
  • Experience collaborating with technical leaders and teams across cloud, security, SRE, release management, and software engineering.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to engage executive leaders and facilitate decisions across teams.
  • Ability to work effectively with global teams, lead through change, and provide technical mentorship.

Required Technical Experience

  • Strong experience with platform engineering and self-service capabilities for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud provisioning, and observability.
  • Experience with GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Operations suite, Anthos, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Scheduler, Bigtable, and AlloyDB.
  • Experience provisioning Google Cloud infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, gateways, security groups, managed services, and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, Packer, Ansible, shell scripting, NX Cloud, Helm, and Argo CD.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Tekton, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, GKE, and Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Experience with application and infrastructure security practices and tools, including SonarQube, Cycode, 42Crunch, Astra, container vulnerability scanning, and FOSSA.
  • Knowledge of microservices architectures and frameworks such as Spring Boot, Micronaut, Ratpack, or Quarkus.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, micro frontends, event-driven systems, APIs, Domain-Driven Design, and serverless technologies.

Great products don't ship on good ideas alone. They ship because someone turns big goals into a clear plan and keeps great teams moving. Here, that's you.

title: Bilingual Clinician
description:
Overview

Westchester Jewish Community Services (WJCS) is an award-winning nonprofit, nonsectarian human services organization founded in 1943. Today, it has grown to be the largest provider of licensed outpatient community behavioral health services and one of the largest human service agencies in Westchester County. WJCS delivers innovative programs and services and compassionate care to more than 20,000 people of all ages and backgrounds throughout the county.

We are seeking a bilingual Clinical Social Worker to join our Victim Services team. In this role, you will conduct thorough assessments, develop individualized treatment plans, and provide evidence-based trauma-focused therapy to clients.

The salary range for this full-time position is $65,000 - $75,000, based on experience and licensure.

Responsibilities

As a valued member of our team, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial intake assessments, and collaboratively develop individualized, evidence-based treatment plans tailored to each client’s trauma-related needs.
  • Regularly monitor and evaluate client progress, updating treatment plans to reflect evolving goals, challenges, and achievements, and actively engage clients in goal-setting and treatment adjustments.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in and consistently apply a wide range of evidence-based trauma-informed practices and therapeutic modalities to ensure effective and culturally sensitive care.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and thorough clinical documentation, including progress notes, treatment updates, court reports, and monthly PMI reports, ensuring compliance with agency, legal, and funding requirements.
  • Provide trauma-informed treatment across multiple modalities, including individual therapy, family therapy, and group sessions, utilizing appropriate interventions based on client presentation and treatment goals.
  • Deliver crisis intervention services with skill, sensitivity, and professionalism, ensuring client safety and stabilization during acute episodes.
  • Maintain ongoing, collaborative communication with the Victims Services team and other relevant stakeholders to coordinate care, share critical information, and support integrated treatment efforts.
  • Supervise and mentor student interns, providing guidance, oversight, and constructive feedback to support their clinical development.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary team members including medical providers, social workers, and legal professionals in a respectful, professional manner to ensure comprehensive client care.
  • Provide emergency response and coverage for hotline services, ensuring prompt and compassionate intervention during crises.

Requirements

We are seeking candidates who possess the following qualifications:

  • Masters Degree in Social Work from an accredited school of social work
  • Possession of license to practice social work in New York State (LMSW or LCSW)
  • Knowledge of current principles and techniques of social work
  • Experience with trauma-focused care, particularly for those impacted by crime or violence
  • Ability to conduct interviews to obtain social and medical information necessary to perform evaluation
  • Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish, both orally and in writing
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships
  • Willingness to work within client’s social context, including home, school or community setting, when needed


What WJCS has to offer you

  • In addition to meaningful work and a supportive team environment, we offer a competitive benefits package, including:
  • Generous paid time off
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits, Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and a Healthcare Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
  • 403(b) Plan and an Agency-Paid Pension Plan
  • Ongoing Professional Development and Training
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition, day-care, and personal emergency reimbursements
  • Disability and life insurance
  • Staff appreciation events and employee mental health and wellness initiatives

title: Product Manager
description:
Position Summary
The Product Manager USA is responsible for defining and driving the product strategy, portfolio development, and market-driven innovation agenda for beMatrix in the United States.
As a member of the beMatrix USA Management Team, the Product Manager USA is accountable for the development, performance, and strategic direction of the beMatrix products and services portfolio within the US market. The role ensures that customer needs, market developments, and business opportunities are systematically identified, validated, and translated into portfolio priorities, business cases, and product development requirements.
Serving as the primary link between the US organization and the global Product Management, Innovation, and R&D teams, the Product Manager USA ensures that the voice of the US customer is integrated early and consistently into product strategy, portfolio planning, and New Product Development activities.
The Product Manager USA leads the local Product Management function and directly manages the Associate Product Manager USA, who supports product development coordination, New Product Introduction, launch execution, stakeholder communication, and product performance follow-up.

Key Responsibilities

1. USA Product Strategy and Portfolio Management
  • Define and execute the USA product and services strategy aligned with the global beMatrix strategy.
  • Lead the USA product and services roadmap and portfolio priorities.
  • Represent the voice of the US customer through structured market, customer and competitive insights.
  • Translate market opportunities and customer needs into business cases, portfolio priorities and product requirements.
  • Balance portfolio optimization, localization of global products and US-specific solutions.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and drive lifecycle management and strategic improvement initiatives.
2. New Product Development & Innovation
  • Lead the USA contribution to the beMatrix New Product Development process.
  • Identify, prioritize and sponsor new product opportunities for the US market.
  • Develop business cases and product requirements in cooperation with HQ Product Management and R&D.
  • Represent the USA organization throughout ideation, development, validation and launch decisions.
  • Participate in Innovation Boards, Product Boards and portfolio reviews.
3. Product Launch & Lifecycle Performance
  • Ensure successful commercialization and adoption of new products within the US market.
  • Define launch strategies in cooperation with Sales, Marketing, Training and Operations.
  • Monitor product performance, adoption, margin and customer feedback.
  • Drive post-launch improvements and lifecycle management actions.
  • Provide market feedback and recommendations to HQ Product Management.
4. Leadership & Global Alignment
  • Lead and develop the Associate Product Manager USA.
  • Serve as the primary interface between beMatrix USA and the global Product Management, Innovation and R&D teams.
  • Align USA market requirements with global roadmap priorities.
  • Represent Product Management within the beMatrix USA Management Team.
  • Promote clear ownership, collaboration and accountability across functions and regions.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Product Management, Marketing or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.
  • Recommended minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in product management, product development, portfolio management or a comparable strategic role.
  • Knowledge of industry regulations and market trends is a plus.​
  • Demonstrated experience leading products through the full lifecycle, from market discovery and business-case development through development, launch and post-launch optimization.
  • Experience working with technical or engineered products, preferably in a B2B environment.
  • Strong understanding of New Product Development, Product Life Cycle Management and portfolio-management principles.
  • Experience working in an international or matrix organization is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across regions, functions and cultures.
  • Willingness to travel within the USA and periodically to beMatrix HQ in Belgium.

title: Engineering Codes and Methods Lead
description:
At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit . Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

Position Overview:

BWXT is seeking an experienced Engineering Codes & Methods Platform Lead for our Advanced Technologies (AT) office in Lynchburg, VA. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical lead for a team responsible for the computational tools and methods that underpin our research and engineering efforts. This role requires substantial technical expertise, demonstrated leadership capability, and the ability to coordinate complex activities across multidisciplinary teams. The successful candidate will possess deep knowledge of modeling and simulation requirements, software quality assurance, and the physics associated with reactor and fuel systems—including neutronics, thermal hydraulics, and structural analyses. They must have exceptional interpersonal skills to coordinate multiple activities simultaneously across joint organizational teams.

Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

Your Day to Day as a Engineering Codes and Methods Platform Lead:

  • Create models and simulations of nuclear reactors and nuclear fuels with historical, specialty, and modern computational tools.
  • Coordinate and/or work with teams in the generation of computational methods, analytical procedures, and organizational / technical processes associated with computational tools and methods.
  • Coordinate multiple research and engineering activities simultaneously within a joint organizational team using scrum project management framework.
  • Execute project engineering activities (task plans, schedules, etc.).
  • Provide technical and strategic direction to teams, ensuring alignment with program objectives and quality standards.
  • Foster a high-performing team environment, including collaboration across multiphysics areas of structural mechanics, thermal/hydraulics, and neutronics.

Required Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.
  • A minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience is required.
  • Must have an understanding of nuclear and non-nuclear phenomena that impact the performance and behavior of systems during normal and off-normal events.
  • Must have an understanding of static and time-dependent behaviors and attributes of physics behind nuclear and non-nuclear systems.
  • Must have knowledge of software configuration, quality, and development best practices and standards is required. Knowledge of revision-controlled software releases through a centralized version control system is required.
  • Must be able to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely written and verbal communication.
  • Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including:
    • Experience facilitating technical teams in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.
    • Ability to provide clear direction, constructive feedback, and effective mentorship
    • Strong decision-making skills with the ability to prioritize and balance competing demands
    • Proven success in fostering collaborative, inclusive, and accountable team culture
  • Travel (<25%) domestic and international.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with nuclear modeling and simulation and relevant nuclear quality standards.
  • Knowledge of MOOSE applications.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.
  • Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.
  • An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.
  • The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

title: Supervisor in Regulatory Reporting Team (Alternatives Investments)
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Location: Kraków


Hybrid model: Hybrid model 3 days per week in the office /2 days for a parent of a child up to 4 years old


About the team: As a Supervisor in Regulatory Reporting Team (alternatives Investments), you will become member of a new team being established to support and transform regulatory reporting. You will be responsible for the day-to-day administration of the current process, including maintenance of existing tools and support for end users, while helping to reshape the process through standardization and automation. The goal is to create an efficient, automated regulatory reporting process and transition it from its current operating model to the new team that you will help build.


In our team, you will be responsible for:

  • Administering the current regulatory reporting process and coordinating day-to-day activities to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
  • Maintaining existing regulatory reporting tools, templates and supporting documentation.
  • Providing ongoing support to end users, responding to queries and resolving process- and tool-related issues.
  • Reviewing the current process and identifying improvement opportunities.
  • Standardizing regulatory reporting processes, controls, data inputs and outputs across relevant areas.
  • Supporting automation initiatives in cooperation with key stakeholders and technology partners to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
  • Supporting the implementation of regulatory changes into reporting processes.
  • Documenting procedures, requirements and controls to support a sustainable and scalable regulatory reporting framework.
  • Supporting the design and build-out of the new regulatory reporting team.
  • Providing ongoing feedback and coaching to staff to improve individual and team performance.

What we’re looking for:

  • At least 4 years of experience in financial reporting and regulatory reporting, accountancy or audit with prior direct responsibility for staff.
  • Primary degree in a finance or accounting related discipline and/or equivalent work experience is an asset.
  • A strong understanding of accounting practices and local regulations.
  • Highly organized, detail oriented with strong reviewing skills and a high degree of accuracy, continuously seeking learning opportunities and striving to achieve the highest level of professional success
  • Pro-active, mature and able to work with respect to the previously agreed timeline.
  • Risk aware mindset with strong focus on implementation of and adherence to internal control
  • Experience in mentoring and coaching staff.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Computer literate with strong Excel skills.

What we offer:

  • Professional trainings and qualification support
  • Wellbeing Program
  • Online Social Fund benefit platform
  • Social, sport and integration events
  • Onboarding Program for new hires

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.
