title: Deputy Director, Product Platforms
description:
About GlobalFoundries:

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.


Summary of Role:

The Deputy Director, Product Platforms will be the entrepreneurial product leader for a differentiated compute-platform portfolio. The role combines product vision, market insight, technical depth, customer leadership, ecosystem development, and commercial accountability. The successful candidate will turn reusable processor, memory, interconnect, security, safety, AI acceleration, I/O, software, and development-tool assets into compelling customizable platform families and derivative products that customers can adopt and scale.

This is not a product-planning-only role. The leader will engage deeply across hardware and software, work directly with customers and partners, drive disciplined product execution, and remain accountable for successful launches, design wins, adoption, and sustained revenue growth.


Essential responsibilities:

· Define and own the multi-year platform vision, product strategy, roadmap, business plan, and investment priorities for the 12nm compute portfolio.

· Maintain an architecture and IP-reuse strategy that is anchored in 12nm but can extend to an adjacent process node when supported by market demand, customer requirements, performance / power / cost needs, supply strategy, or portfolio economics.

· Translate market trends and customer use cases into platform requirements spanning CPU architecture, memory hierarchy, coherent interconnect / NoC, accelerators, high-speed I/O, security, functional safety, package, power, software, tools, and reference systems.

· Create a coherent platform family and derivative strategy rather than isolated one-off products; define where configuration, customer IP integration, chiplets, companion devices, or custom derivatives create differentiated value.

· Own product requirements, target specifications, competitive positioning, pricing strategy, business cases, lifecycle plans, and clear go / no-go recommendations.

· Lead cross-functional platform execution with architecture, silicon design, verification, physical design, DFT, package, test, validation, software, applications, operations, quality, finance, sales, and marketing.

· Drive the full launch process from concept and business approval through platform definition, development, pre-silicon enablement, sampling, production release, market launch, customer ramp, and post-launch optimization.

· Build the whole-product plan, including virtual platforms, FPGA prototypes, evaluation systems, SDKs, Linux / RTOS enablement, drivers, toolchains, reference designs, documentation, training, and field collateral.

· Develop and manage an ecosystem of processor / IP providers, EDA partners, OS and middleware vendors, toolchain and debug partners, design services firms, board partners, distributors, and application-domain partners.

· Establish executive-level relationships with strategic customers and partners; lead discovery, roadmap alignment, product definition, commercial framing, design-win strategy, and escalation resolution.

· Partner with sales and field teams to build the opportunity pipeline, segment target accounts, improve customer identification and win rate, and convert early engagements into design wins and production revenue.

· Own platform KPIs, including roadmap execution, launch readiness, design wins, qualified pipeline, ecosystem readiness, customer adoption, gross margin, forecast accuracy, revenue growth, and return on investment.

· Continuously assess competitive offerings, technology shifts, market inflections, and build / buy / partner choices; adjust the roadmap with speed and discipline.

· Communicate a clear, credible platform narrative to executives, customers, partners, field teams, and engineering organizations, balancing vision with evidence and execution realism.

· Commercial judgment: ability to balance NRE and customer specific developments with a platform reuse approach, derivative economics, margin, schedule, customer specificity, and long-term portfolio leverage.


Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications:

· Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a closely related technical field; advanced technical or business degree is a plus.

· 8+ years of semiconductor, embedded-computing, processor, SoC, platform, or closely related product experience, including 5+ years in product management, platform leadership, product marketing, applications, systems, or a comparable customer-facing technical leadership role.

· Strong background in 32-bit or 64-bit compute products, with 64-bit MPU, application-processor, edge-compute, infrastructure, or Linux-class product experience strongly preferred.

· Demonstrated understanding of SoC hardware and software, including prior hands-on or leadership involvement in both domains. Experience may include silicon architecture, systems, applications, firmware, BSP / SDK, operating systems, drivers, validation, or product engineering.

· Proven record of successful semiconductor or embedded-platform launches, from market definition and requirements through customer adoption and production ramp.

· Demonstrated product revenue growth, design-win creation, portfolio expansion, or turnaround results supported by concrete business metrics.

· Experience creating or scaling a software, tools, IP, and partner ecosystem around a compute product or platform.

· Strong customer and partner relationships, with the credibility to engage engineering leaders, product executives, architects, procurement, and business decision makers.

· Ability to build rigorous market models, product P&Ls, pricing and margin frameworks, investment cases, forecast ranges, and measurable launch plans.

· Excellent leadership and influence skills across matrixed organizations; able to align strong technical and commercial stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.

· Clear executive communication, strong judgment under uncertainty, high ownership, and willingness to move between strategy, detail, and customer execution.


Preferred Qualification:

· Experience with RISC-V, Arm, MIPS, or comparable processor architectures; multicore SoCs; MMUs and virtualization; coherent fabrics; cache / DDR subsystems; PCIe, Ethernet, SerDes, or other high-speed interfaces.

· Experience with Linux-class products and software enablement, including boot flow, firmware, drivers, SDKs, virtual platforms, FPGA prototyping, evaluation boards, and developer tooling.

· Exposure to AI / ML acceleration, vector processing, edge inference, networking offload, functional safety, cybersecurity, HSM / root of trust, or long-lifecycle industrial and automotive products.

· Experience managing process-node, foundry, package, test, yield, cost, supply, and lifecycle tradeoffs for semiconductor products.

· Experience with configurable platforms, product derivatives, custom silicon, customer IP integration, or platform reuse across multiple end markets.

· Established network across customers and ecosystem partners in edge compute, industrial, robotics, machine vision, infrastructure or automotive.

· Experience leading geographically distributed teams and operating across engineering, field, partner, and executive communities.


Leadership Profile

Visionary and market-back

Connects technology inflections and customer pain points to a differentiated, investable platform roadmap.

Self-motivated owner

Creates momentum, closes gaps, and drives decisions without waiting for a fully defined playbook.

Technical product leader

Can challenge architects and software leaders while translating tradeoffs into customer and business outcomes.

Commercially accountable

Treats launch, adoption, margin, and revenue as core product responsibilities, not downstream sales tasks.

Ecosystem builder

Understands that processors win through software, tools, partners, reference systems, and developer confidence.

Customer credible

Builds trust through preparation, transparency, technical command, and reliable follow-through.

Platform thinker

Optimizes for reuse and scalable derivatives while recognizing when a strategic customer-specific investment is justified.

Decisive and adaptable

Makes evidence-based decisions with incomplete information, explicitly manages risk, and adjusts quickly as facts change.


Success Measures

· Clear, approved platform strategy and roadmap with explicit market, customer, product, software, ecosystem, financial, and process-node choices.

· Launch milestones achieved with measurable readiness across silicon, software, tools, boards, documentation, field enablement, supply, and quality.

· Priority customer opportunities converted into architecture engagements, design wins, and credible production-revenue paths.

· Platform and derivative portfolio demonstrates disciplined reuse of IP, software, validation, infrastructure, and commercial investments.

· Ecosystem gaps identified early and closed through internal development, licensing, co-development, or strategic partnerships.

· Revenue, margin, design-win pipeline, product adoption, and portfolio return improve against agreed business targets.

· Field, customer, partner, and engineering teams operate from one product narrative, one prioritized roadmap, and transparent decision gates.

Preferred Target Talent Pools

· Product or platform leaders from embedded processor, MPU, BMC, industrial compute, vision SoC, networking, data-center infrastructure, or edge-AI semiconductor companies.

· Experience with products serving multiple markets rather than only a single customer or single vertical.

· Experience with customer-funded or anchor-funded platform development models, derivative roadmaps, and ecosystem/software readiness.

· Customer-facing credibility with engineering, architecture, platform, and advanced technology teams.

The strongest candidate will combine engineering credibility, whole-product hardware/software judgment, customer and ecosystem leadership, successful launch evidence, and quantified revenue ownership. 64-bit product experience is preferred, but an exceptional 32-bit platform leader with credible SW/Market Focos/ Linux / MPU adjacency should remain in scope.

Expected Salary Range

$171,000.00 - $296,000.00

The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at usaccommodations@gf.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

GlobalFoundries goal of excellence in business necessitates the attraction and retention of highly qualified people. title: Software Engineer - Bulgaria, Early Career
description:
About DeepInfra


DeepInfra is building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of AI. We believe open-source models are the future, and companies should have full control over their AI stack without being locked into proprietary providers.

Our inference platform serves trillions of tokens every week across hundreds of production workloads. We build everything from GPU infrastructure to the API layer because every millisecond matters.

We are looking for early-career Software Engineers (0-2 years of experience, including internships) to join our team.

Why this role matters


You’ll work closely with our experienced engineers to design, build, and scale infrastructure for serving top open-source AI models. This role is ideal for recent graduates or junior engineers who want to grow quickly while working on high-impact, real production AI systems.

If you’re excited about AI/ML, have taken related courses or built projects, and want to learn how to ship things at scale - we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do


  • Collaborate with engineers to design, develop, and test inference solutions for state-of-the-art AI models.
  • Implement, optimize, and evaluate AI models using Python, C++, CUDA, and NCCL (previous exposure helpful - deep expertise not required).
  • Monitor and maintain production model-serving systems.
  • Work on new features, fix bugs, and contribute to code reviews.
  • Participate in daily standups, design reviews, and team discussions.
  • Explore new AI/ML techniques and tools, and experiment with improving model performance.
  • Try new things. Ship stuff.


What You Bring


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (completed or in final year).
  • Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
  • Proficiency in Python, including experience with AI/ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., NumPy, pandas, SciPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience with AI/ML through coursework, research, personal projects, full-time employment, or internships.
  • Familiarity with AI models, Transformers and Diffusers.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and optimize code.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity, willingness to learn, and desire to build real systems.

Bonus


  • Exposure to C++, CUDA, or AI inference.
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects.


Why DeepInfra


  • Work on cutting-edge AI model serving - the systems that power the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models.
  • Small team, huge impact: your work ships directly to customers.
  • Opportunity to learn from engineers building high-performance inference at scale.
  • Fast-paced environment with ownership, autonomy, and end-to-end responsibility.

How we work


Three traits define the people who thrive here, and this role leans on all three.

Initiative. We take ownership and step in where we can add value. Whether it’s starting something new, improving what exists, or helping move ideas forward, we aim to be proactive and thoughtful in how we contribute.

Drive. We’re energized by hard problems. Building AI infrastructure is complex, and we lean into that. We care about doing things well, moving fast, and continuously improving because solving meaningful challenges is what motivates us.

Grit. Things don’t always work on the first try and that’s expected. We stay persistent, adapt quickly, and learn as we go. We take setbacks seriously, but not personally, and use them to get better.

What you get


  • Highly competitive compensation package, including additional stock options
  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus up to 3 well-being days per year
  • Additional private health insurance, so you’re covered beyond the basics
  • Company lunch every working day
  • Quarterly performance reviews to support your growth
  • Team gatherings, conferences and business trips across Europe and Silicon Valley

title: Coordinator of Youth and Young Adult Ministries - Outside of Columbus
description:
JOB TITLE: Coordinator of Youth and Young Adult Ministries
PARISH: Cathedral of Christ the King, Lexington, KY
DEPARTMENT: Faith Formation
REPORTS TO: Director of Faith Formation
POSITION
This is a salaried, full-time position with benefits which could include attendance at meetings outside of a regular Monday through Friday, and 37.5 hour per week work schedule. Evening and weekend work is required. Some portions of this position may be performed remotely, with the authorization of the Director of Faith Formation.

This position is responsible for working in collaboration with the Director of Faith Formation to develop, coordinate and administer faith formation programs for children in the range of 5th grade through Young Adult (18-35). It provides education and support to families with the Youth of the parish. It is an extension of the Faith Formation Department.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
Coordinate and supervise volunteers within the Youth Ministry grades 5 through Young Adult age.
QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE

Able to attend various committee / Staff meetings which are scheduled during normal working hours as well as some evenings.

ESSENTIAL VALUES
”Teacher, which commandment in the law is the greatest?” He said to him, “You shall love the Lord, your God, with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind. This is the greatest and the first commandment. The second is like it: You shall love your neighbor as yourself. The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.” -Matt 22:36-40
This is what love of God and neighbor looks like at the Cathedral of Christ the King: Orthodoxy, Honesty, Initiative, Humility, Integrity, Dependability, Teamwork, Transparency, Accountability, Communication, and Reverence.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with physical challenges to perform these essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to feel objects with tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear. The employee

title: Research Associate
description:
Please refer to the How to Apply for a Job (for External Candidates) job aid for instructions on how to apply.

If you are an active McGill employee (ie: currently in an active contract or position at McGill University), do not apply through this Career Site. Login to your McGill Workday account and apply to this posting using the Find Jobs report (type Find Jobs in the search bar).

The Department of Mechanical Engineering at McGill University is seeking a Research Associate for the Reprogrammable metamaterials research project under the supervision of Professor Damiano Pasini.


This role will contribute to the analysis, design, fabrication, and testing of mechanical metamaterials.


This is a unionized position, and the incumbent will be a member of the AMURE (Research Associates and Assistants) bargaining unit.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and design optimize metamaterial unit cells and lattice architectures with tunable or switchable mechanical properties, including multistable, origami/kirigami-inspired and stimuli-responsive designs.
  • Develop analytical and computational models (e.g., finite element analysis, discrete/reduced-order models) to predict nonlinear mechanical behavior, instabilities and reconfiguration pathways.
  • Fabricate prototypes using additive manufacturing (multi-material 3D printing, laser cutting) and other fabrication techniques.
  • Plan and conduct mechanical experiments (quasi-static and dynamic testing, digital image correlation) to characterize and validate metamaterial performance.
  • Investigate actuation and programming strategies using mechanical, thermal, magnetic or electrical stimuli.
  • Analyze data, interpret results and compare experimental findings with theoretical predictions.
  • Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals, present at conferences, and contribute to grant proposals and reports.
  • Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team and mentor undergraduate and graduate students involved in the design, fabrication, testing, and analysis of reprogrammable mechanical metamaterials.

Qualifications:

  • PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Physics or related fields.
  • At least five (5) years of research experience.
  • Strong background in solid mechanics, multiscale theory, nonlinear elasticity, structural stability and buckling.
  • Proficiency with finite element software (e.g., ABAQUS, COMSOL or ANSYS) and scientific programming (Python or MATLAB).
  • Knowledge of mechanical metamaterials, architected materials or soft/smart materials.
  • Experience with mechanical testing equipment and experimental data analysis.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.

How you will make history here...

The Associate Director, Operational Excellence, is accountable for implementing Operational Excellence as a way of working within the plant. The implementation of Operational Excellence includes the Operating System, Management Infrastructure and Mindsets, Behaviors & Capabilities supported by Industry 4.0. Activities include leading cross functional Opex teams, leading Opex workstreams, driving daily issue resolution and performance improvements across all key metrics across the site scorecard. This is a critical role with oversight for the implementation of world-class operational excellence strategies to optimize supply chain improvements and improve the cost of product sold. This role requires close collaboration with key Supply Chain functions such as Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Human Resources, and Logistics. This position will have exposure to and will interface with Plant Managers, Operations Managers and will influence site direction.

What you will do...

Execute OPEX capability training sessions for the site leadership team, front line leadership team, and frontline employees. Will be the site's lead trainer for all continuous improvement tools.
• Cost Management: Ensure improvements identified in OPEX team charters are rolled into the plant enabler program to capture enabler savings. Track OPEX team performance to ensure improvements are sustained, and long-term countermeasures are tracked and implemented. Will execute Zero Loss analysis to identify loss opportunities and build the enabler pipeline.
• Stakeholder Influence: Coach and work collaboratively to influence stakeholders to effect change throughout an organization by leading through others.

• Strategic Deployment: Responsible for deploying the Campbell’s Operational Excellence strategy to drive Supply Chain performance to world-class levels.

• Anticipating Challenges: Anticipating internal and external business challenges and regulatory issues, recommending process, product, or service improvements.
• Problem Solving: Solving unique and complex problems that have a broad impact on the business, contributing to the development of functional strategy.

description:

Summary of Role:

New College Graduate position within the GF Test Development organization supporting Silicon Photonics (SiPh) semiconductor technologies for high-speed data center, high-performance computing, and hyperscale computing applications. This engineer will develop and improve automated optical and electrical test solutions used to characterize photonic integrated circuits (PICs), analyze device performance, and support reliable technology development and product qualification.


Essential Responsibilities include:

  • Develop, execute, and document optical and electrical test plans for silicon photonic integrated circuits, including automated instrument control, test sequencing, data acquisition, and analysis in a Linux environment using Python and C/C++.
  • Perform device and circuit characterization, including DC current-voltage (I-V), capacitance-voltage (C-V), optical insertion loss, waveguide loss, wavelength response, fiber-to-chip coupling efficiency, photodetector responsivity, modulator transfer characteristics, and electro-optic bandwidth measurements.
  • Own and improve high-speed test methods using vector network analyzers, optical power meters, tunable lasers, oscilloscopes, optical spectrum analyzers, stimulus and measuring units, probe stations, and RF/optical probes; support calibration, de-embedding, correlation, measurement repeatability, and uncertainty evaluation.
  • Analyze large characterization datasets using AI, statistical methods to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and sources of variation; troubleshoot hardware, software, and data-quality issues, communicate results in technical reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve test coverage, throughput, and measurement capability.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education – Graduating with Bachelor’s in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Photonics, Optical Engineering or related field from an accredited degree program.
  • Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and proven good academic standing.
  • Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior related internship or co-op experience.
  • Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc.
  • Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making.
  • Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong planning & organizational skills
  • Advanced programming experience in a Linux environment using Python and C/C++; experience with R or Perl is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of silicon photonics, optical and electrical device characterization, high-speed or mm-wave circuits, statistics, and experimental test methodology; hands-on laboratory, capstone, or research experience is preferred.

Working onsite enables real-time collaboration, strong team connections, direct mentorship, and the hands-on partnership needed to deliver our mission. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Licensing Specialist

Position Overview:

Maintain NRC and state radioactive materials licenses, including change requests and documentation. Serves as regulatory interface on licensing and compliance matters. Coordinates follow-up efforts to NRC and state compliance inspections. Serves as compliance resource for packaging and transport of radioactive materials, including packages requiring NRC approval.

Location:

On-site in Erwin, Tennessee.

Your Day to Day as a Licensing Specialist:

1. Plans and organizes the NFS Erwin activities associated with NRC and state licensing, including license applications, amendment and renewal requests, decommissioning requests, and associated documentation.

2. Prepares licensing submittals to regulatory agencies, directs the consolidation of licensing input from all areas of the company for submittal to regulatory agencies and exercises judgement based on the analysis of multiple sources of information.

3. Supports reviews of the NFS licensing programs for compliance with appropriate governmental rules and regulations.

4. Interfaces with and provides assistance to NRC and other regulatory inspectors and licensing personnel.

5. Establishes liaison with and acts as a licensing resource to other team members and groups such as Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Health Physics, Industrial Safety, and Environmental Safety on matters pertaining to license and regulatory compliance.

6. Review regulatory information notices, new regulations, inspection reports, and related documents and advise responsible groups on action necessary to achieve compliance.

7. Administers the activities associated with tracking regulatory commitments including entering the commitments into the correction action program systems, generating reports to track the status of the commitments, and ensuring they are properly documented to support closure.

8. Solves complex licensing problems; takes on new perspectives on existing licensing solutions; and uses best licensing practices and knowledge to improve the licensing program.

9. Works independently acting as a licensing resource for colleagues with less knowledge of regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications:

B. S./B. A. -- Engineering, Physical Science or Business Administration

With a B. S. degree, it requires 6-8 years of experience. Previous experience with regulatory requirements and regulatory agencies is required. This can include experience in the nuclear field involving areas such as licensing, regulatory compliance, quality assurance or directly related experience in a highly-regulated business.

Collabria Financial Inc. is a leading Canadian credit card issuer. title: ADAS Vehicle Motion Performance Engineer
description:
We bring engineering ideas to life. In Product Development, we make driving more exciting, enjoyable, and sustainable. Ford's Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) team designs and develops hardware and functional models that deliver best-in-class behavior for features like Adaptive Cruise Control, Automatic Emergency Braking, Cross Traffic Alert, Lane Centering Assist, BlueCruise, and 360-Degree Camera Systems. We are seeking seasoned professionals with experience in vehicle motion control to contribute to our efforts. This position focuses on leading and supporting vehicle motion engineering development for our BlueCruise features.

What you'll do...

  • Translate customer and corporate vehicle motion performance needs and requirements into (sub)system requirements and specifications

  • Develop the longitudinal and lateral vehicle motion performance attributes for BlueCruise features

  • Develop and validate vehicle motion performance algorithms in-vehicle

  • Create in-vehicle Design Verification Methods for vehicle motion

  • Calibrate vehicle motion performance algorithms in-vehicle

  • Develop in-vehicle toolsets that support development of the vehicle motion performance attribute

  • Lead and coordinate root-cause analysis of vehicle motion performance error states

  • Utilize AI tools and agents for data analysis and calibration optimization

  • Travel to Arizona 2 - 4 weeks annually as needed.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Controls Engineering, or a closely related field

  • 3+ years of in-vehicle lateral or longitudinal motion development experience

  • 3+ years of experience working with MATLAB/Simulink

  • Knowledge of vehicle dynamics and chassis components

  • Ability to lead a small project, demonstrate ownership, and take initiative to further improve features

Even better, you may have...

  • Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Controls Engineering, or a closely related field

  • 5+ years of industry experience with steering, brake systems, and/or chassis controls development

  • 5+ years of industry experience with ADAS features and/or autonomous vehicle controls

  • Strong background in vehicle dynamics, system identification, optimization and control. Deep understanding and application experience in advanced model-based control techniques, including state estimation, Kalman filtering, linear and nonlinear control methods

  • Hardware hands-on experience highly preferred, including experience in dSpace rapid prototyping, Vector tools.

  • Demonstrated experience reviewing, categorizing, and analyzing field data to determine error states and failure modes

  • Demonstrated experience with model-based design methods in Simulink for the creation, development, and enhancement of current and new features

  • Algorithm development experience in any language (C, C++, Python, MATLAB, etc.)

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

title: Co-Op, Automation, Digital Manufacturing & Controls
description:
The Role


This is a winter / spring co-op opportunity in Norwood, MA from January 18, 2027 – June 25, 2027. Applicants must be available for the entire duration of the co-op. Start date will be January 18, 2027.


The Automation, Digital Manufacturing & Controls Co-op will support digital, software, data, automation, controls, and manufacturing systems capabilities that enable Moderna’s manufacturing and operational teams. Will support the digital systems and data capabilities that enable Moderna’s manufacturing operations. This role will provide hands-on exposure to how manufacturing data is generated, managed, integrated, and used within a regulated GMP environment.


The co-op will work alongside Manufacturing, Digital, Automation, Quality, and Engineering teams to support initiatives related to manufacturing data, system integrations, reporting, analytics, data quality, and continuous improvement. Projects may include analyzing manufacturing data, improving data visibility, supporting system and process documentation, troubleshooting data issues, developing dashboards or applications, and helping evaluate opportunities to enable manufacturing operations through software, data, automation, and digital technologies.


This role is designed for a student interested in applying software, data, automation, controls, and digital technologies to real-world manufacturing and operational challenges. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to learn about GMP manufacturing systems, regulated data practices, and the digital technologies that support modern biopharmaceutical manufacturing while contributing to meaningful projects used by operational teams.

This position is site-based, requiring you to be at Moderna’s site full-time. This position is not eligible for remote work.


Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with experienced automation engineers and developers to quickly learn automation platforms, tools, and best practices.
  • Assist in developing, configuring, integrating, and testing digital, automation, controls, and manufacturing systems such as PCS, MES, data platforms, and PLC-based systems.
  • Develop, test, and deploy software applications, data products, APIs, integrations, or automation solutions that address real manufacturing and operational needs.
  • Apply appropriate software and engineering practices such as version control, code review, testing, debugging, modular development, and technical documentation to produce reliable and maintainable solutions.
  • Build or update dashboards, reports, analytical tools, or data products using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, or other relevant technologies.
  • Support troubleshooting data flow issues between manufacturing systems, databases, and reporting tools.
  • Assist with testing changes to manufacturing data systems (PCS, MES, DH, PLC, etc), reports, or integrations before deployment.
  • Document system configurations, data flows, business processes, troubleshooting steps, and standard work.
  • Work with Manufacturing, Automation, Quality, and Digital teams to understand business, operational, and technical needs and translate them into technical requirements.
  • Support investigations by gathering system data, logs, timestamps, or other technical information.
  • Participate in project meetings, daily team discussions, and technical reviews.
  • Assist with user acceptance testing, regression testing, or validation-related activities for GMP computerized systems.
  • Review data trends and summarize findings for engineers, manufacturing teams, or project leads.
  • Learn the underlying manufacturing process so they can understand the context behind the data they are working with.
  • Support GMP documentation, testing, and validation activities.
  • Follow and apply industry and GMP standards in pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Basic Qualifications)

  • Current student enrolled in a Bachelors or Masters program in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Biotechnology, or a related technical field.
  • Basic understanding of one or more relevant technical areas such as programming, databases, APIs, automation, controls, version control, or information systems, gained through coursework, projects, or previous experience.
  • Experience analyzing data using at least one tool such as Python, Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, or similar.
  • Ability to analyze and troubleshoot problems in a methodical manner.
  • Interest in learning about GMP manufacturing and computerized systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and the ability to contribute to cross-functional teams.
  • Curiosity about process automation development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • At Moderna, we are focused on delivering on our mission by enabling talent to thrive. For this role, we are currently unable to offer immigration sponsorship. Candidates must already hold work authorization in US and be able to maintain that status without the need for future sponsorship.

  • GPA of 3.5 on a 4 scale or equivalent.

  • Demonstrated hands-on technical experience through coursework, personal projects, research, internships, open-source contributions, or an optional code/project portfolio (e.g., GitHub). Prior experience in a GMP environment.

As we build our company, we have always believed that an in-person culture is critical to our success. This role is 100% onsite, reflecting the importance of being physically present to support the work, collaborate closely with colleagues, and contribute to our site-based operations.


Working onsite enables real-time collaboration, strong team connections, direct mentorship, and the hands-on partnership needed to deliver our mission. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

title: IT Infrastructure & Security Specialist

Job Description:

Leonardo is an international industrial group and one of the world's leading companies in the Aerospace, Defence, and Security sectors, delivering multi-domain technological capabilities in the fields of Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cyber Security, and Space.

Within Leonardo’s Space Division, e-GEOS—a company owned by ASI (20%) and Telespazio (80%)—is a leading international player in the Earth Observation and geospatial information sector, offering a unique portfolio of application services.

Within our department "Digital Soluntion and IT" we are looking for an

to contribute to the operation, evolution and security of ICT infrastructures and technological platforms supporting Earth Observation, Defence & Intelligence and geospatial services.

The successful candidate will operate in complex and mission-critical environments, contributing to the technological infrastructure supporting the processing, management and delivery of geospatial information and Defence & Intelligence services.

The role requires a hands-on, proactive and cross-functional approach, combining systems and infrastructure engineering, cybersecurity principles, automation and advanced troubleshooting, while collaborating with internal IT teams, application specialists, operational users and technology partners.

What you'll do

Manage and evolve Linux and Windows Server infrastructures, ensuring availability, performance, security and operational continuity.

Administer virtualization, compute, networking, storage, backup and containerized environments supporting operational and geospatial platforms.

Contribute to the secure operation of infrastructures supporting Earth Observation and Defence & Intelligence services, including processing and delivery environments.

Manage identity, access-control and network-segmentation mechanisms in environments with enhanced security and confidentiality requirements.

Implement system hardening, security baselines and vulnerability remediation.

Develop and maintain infrastructure monitoring, automation and configuration-management processes.

Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues, perform root cause analysis and coordinate remediation with internal teams and technology vendors.

Support infrastructure migrations, upgrades, capacity planning, lifecycle management and technical acceptance activities.

Work with application and operational teams to translate requirements into secure, resilient and maintainable infrastructure solutions.

Contribute proactively to the evolution, resilience and continuous improvement of mission-critical IT services.

Requirements

At least 5 years of hands-on professional experience in systems administration, IT infrastructure or infrastructure security.

Strong knowledge of Linux and Windows Server environments.

Solid experience with virtualization and enterprise infrastructure architectures.

Good knowledge of networking technologies including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, DNS, firewalling and access control.

Experience with enterprise storage, backup and data services.

Knowledge of identity-management technologies such as Active Directory, Group Policy and LDAP.

Familiarity with monitoring, automation and configuration-management technologies.

Good understanding of cybersecurity principles applied to infrastructure, including hardening, least privilege, network segmentation and vulnerability management.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, with the ability to independently drive complex technical issues through to resolution.

Ability to collaborate effectively across infrastructure, application and operational teams and with external suppliers.

Proactive attitude, strong ownership and focus on delivery.

Good written and spoken English.

Education

University degree. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, Cyber Security, Information Technology or another STEM discipline is preferred; candidates with a different academic background combined with significant professional experience in complex IT infrastructures will also be considered.

Postgraduate education, professional qualifications or specialised training related to Cyber Security, Space, Earth Observation, Intelligence or Defence technologies will be considered an advantage.

Earth Observation and geospatial information systems

Defence & Intelligence or IMINT-related technological environments

HPC and compute-intensive processing infrastructures

title: Remediation Project Manager
description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting-edge and next-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.


Overview:

The Remediation Project Manager position is an exciting role in the FMC Corporate Environmental Remediation group for someone with a desire to manage environmental remediation projects. In this position, you will lead diverse teams, directing all phases of remediation projects at your assigned sites and support the teams involved in all remediation and construction projects. As a Remediation Project Manager, you will report to the Remediation Portfolio Manager.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement remedial strategies for assigned remediation sites safely and within budget.
  • Manage all projects to FMC safety standards and implement FMC’s culture of safety at all sites.
  • Select, manage and deploy diverse teams of specialists to direct all phases of site remediation projects, including field execution and construction, decontamination, and demolition activities.
  • Develop estimates for annual spend on projects. Meet project budgets, prepare all necessary authorization documents for spending and cost controls. Develop monthly forecasts to ensure tracking to budget.
  • Negotiate with governmental authorities the appropriate scope of work, the best alternatives for site remediation, and the level of FMC involvement at assigned remediation sites.
  • Retain and manage environmental consultants, laboratories and remedial contractors.
  • Prepare and present presentations to partners, including senior leadership, on project status, strategies, costs, progress, and new issues.
  • Communicate with management, other department members, other key FMC stakeholders (legal, procurement, finance, sustainability, etc.), and outside contractors on a variety of matters, including project status and other issues.
  • Critically review and edit for accuracy, style and content all reports, correspondence, field records, etc. which are prepared to document project work.
  • Identify new issues and trends on remediation project work and communicate relevant matters with the appropriate audience.
  • Occasional travel to project sites to actively manage and assist in the oversight of remedial construction and to participate in key regulatory and stakeholder meetings

Required Education:

  • BS in Engineering, Natural Science, or related field


Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of environmental remediation and project management experience with 3+ years of experience working with federal or state environmental agencies on remediation issues. Sound understanding of USEPA and state agency policies and procedures, patterns of agency action and non-action, and typical responses.
  • Experience working with regulatory agencies, required. Previous work experience in an Industrial Corporate Environmental setting and/or working in a facility is preferred.
  • Previous responsibility for overseeing safety, technical, organizational management, and financial aspects of multiple simultaneous environmental projects.
  • Experience analyzing project requirements with important partners, evaluating feasibility, and developing a strategy for implementation.
  • Skill coordinating and overseeing safe field execution, construction, decontamination and demolition activities.
  • Experience managing projects, preferably >$5M annually, and developing project plans and schedules to implement and track project status.
  • Knowledge of environmental reserves and requirements imposed by government agencies.
  • Previous experience exercising practical judgment and ability to make data-driven decisions within context of defined processes.
  • Proficient in using common computer software, including: Microsoft Word®, Excel®, and PowerPoint® and SAP® (preferred).

Additional preferred qualifications:

  • Technical knowledge and experience in complex environmental, occupational health, or worker safety subject areas in a manufacturing environment.
  • Direct management of environmental, health, and safety requirements, such as permit acquisition and compliance auditing.
  • Experience managing capital projects.
  • Experience with USEPA RCRA and CERCLA remediation programs
  • Professional licensure and certifications such as Professional Engineer (P.E.), Professional Geologist (P.G.), Licensed Site Remediation Professional (LSRP), Project Management Professional (PMP), or similar credentials are preferred but not required. Candidates with advanced degrees in environmental engineering, geology, environmental science, or related fields are also encouraged to apply.

title: VP, Engineering
description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Why Campbell’s…

  • Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
  • Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
  • Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
  • If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
  • Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
  • Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Engineering provides enterprise leadership for engineering strategy, capital investment, automation, infrastructure, manufacturing technology, and technical capability across the manufacturing network. This executive is accountable for translating business priorities into safe, reliable, scalable, and financially sound solutions that strengthen growth, productivity, innovation, sustainability, quality, and operational performance.

The VP of Engineering leads through partnership and service. This leader brings together Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, Quality, Finance, Procurement, EH&S, Human Resources, Commercial, and external experts to define needs, evaluate alternatives, and deliver the best enterprise outcome. The role creates clarity, removes barriers, develops people, and enables teams closest to the work to contribute meaningfully to solution design and execution.

The role oversees an annual capital portfolio exceeding $150 million and ensures that the strongest available internal and external expertise is applied to major capital programs, network investments, technology modernization, and complex operational challenges. Success requires disciplined governance, shared ownership, rigorous technical review, and solutions that are practical to operate, maintain, and sustain.


Key Responsibilities


Engineering Strategy, Servant Leadership & Capability

• Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise engineering strategy aligned with business growth, network needs, productivity, sustainability, innovation, and operational excellence priorities.

• Lead with a servant leadership mindset by listening actively, creating clarity, removing organizational and technical barriers, and enabling teams to perform at their best.

• Build a high-performing, inclusive engineering organization that values humility, accountability, curiosity, collaboration, and service to manufacturing and the broader enterprise.

• Develop engineering talent through coaching, stretch assignments, succession planning, communities of practice, and purposeful exposure to enterprise priorities.

• Establish clear engineering standards, governance, project management disciplines, and decision rights while empowering capable teams to act with appropriate speed and ownership.

• Create an environment where technical debate is welcomed, lessons are shared, and the best idea is advanced regardless of its source.


Cross-Functional Solution Development

• Partner with Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, Quality, Finance, Procurement, EH&S, HR, Commercial, and other stakeholders from problem definition through design, execution, commissioning, and benefits realization.

• Ensure business, operational, technical, safety, quality, financial, workforce, and customer perspectives are integrated into major decisions and solution designs.

• Build shared ownership by engaging plant teams, operators, maintenance, technical specialists, and functional leaders early and throughout the project lifecycle.

• Facilitate alignment across stakeholders, surface tradeoffs transparently, and resolve issues in the best interest of the enterprise rather than a single function.

• Partner with innovation and commercial teams to ensure new products, processes, and technologies are designed for manufacturability, scalability, reliability, and sustainable execution.

• Use influence, trust, and fact-based recommendations to align senior leaders around complex enterprise decisions.


Technical Excellence & Expertise Networks

• Establish a deliberate approach for identifying, convening, and leveraging the best available internal and external expertise for each opportunity or challenge.

• Create strong technical networks and communities of practice across processing, packaging, utilities, facilities, automation, controls, reliability, digital manufacturing, and project execution.

• Ensure major solutions receive rigorous multidisciplinary technical review, appropriate challenge, and validation before investment and implementation.

• Engage subject matter experts, manufacturing teams, strategic suppliers, consultants, and industry partners based on the needs and risks of the work.

• Promote standardization and reuse of proven designs while allowing thoughtful adaptation to site, product, process, and customer requirements.

• Capture and share technical knowledge, project learnings, benchmarks, and standards so expertise is scalable across the network and not concentrated in individuals or locations.

• Benchmark external practices and emerging technologies to maintain best-in-class technical capability and avoid insular decision-making.


Capital Portfolio Management & Project Delivery

• Lead and govern an annual capital investment portfolio of $150M+ in partnership with business, finance, manufacturing, supply chain, and functional leaders.

• Develop long-range capital plans that support capacity, network optimization, automation, infrastructure renewal, asset reliability, compliance, growth, and cost competitiveness.

• Prioritize investments using transparent criteria that consider strategic value, operational need, technical risk, financial return, resource capacity, and enterprise interdependencies.

• Ensure project teams apply fit-for-purpose governance, front-end planning, risk management, technical assurance, change control, and benefits tracking.

• Create shared accountability for projects to be delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with the intended operational and financial outcomes.

• Ensure solutions are developed with the people who will operate and maintain them, with clear plans for training, commissioning, startup, handoff, and sustained performance.


Manufacturing & Operational Excellence

• Partner with manufacturing and plant leadership to improve safety, asset utilization, throughput, reliability, quality, yield, labor effectiveness, and cost performance.

• Apply Lean, TPM, Six Sigma, reliability-centered maintenance, and other relevant methodologies in ways that build local capability and solve the underlying business need.

• Champion practical digital manufacturing, automation, controls, data, and smart factory solutions that strengthen decision-making and workforce effectiveness.

• Provide responsive technical support for complex operating challenges while building the capability of teams to diagnose, solve, and prevent recurrence.

• Balance near-term operational support with long-term asset, technology, and capability strategies.


Safety, Quality, Compliance & Sustainability

• Embed worker safety, food safety, quality, environmental stewardship, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance into the earliest stages of engineering decisions and designs.

• Ensure engineering standards and solutions meet applicable corporate, FDA, OSHA, environmental, and industry requirements.

• Partner with EH&S, Quality, Operations, and technical experts to identify risk, apply appropriate controls, and verify that solutions perform as intended.

• Advance sustainability priorities, including energy efficiency, waste reduction, water conservation, emissions reduction, and responsible use of resources.

Innovation & Technology Advancement

• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices through structured collaboration with

R&D, Operations, IT, Supply Chain, Procurement, suppliers, and technical partners.

• Lead disciplined pilots and scale-up efforts that test technical feasibility, operational value, workforce impact, and economic return before broader deployment.

• Enable innovative processing, packaging, automation, digital, and infrastructure solutions that improve growth, resilience, productivity, quality, and cost competitiveness.

• Ensure technology decisions are interoperable, supportable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and long-term manufacturing strategy.


Qualifications


Required

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, including Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 15 years of progressive engineering leadership experience within food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or a related manufacturing industry.

• Minimum 10 years leading large, multi-site engineering organizations or complex enterprise technical networks.

• Demonstrated accountability for an annual capital portfolio exceeding $150 million.

• Proven success delivering large-scale capital programs, automation initiatives, infrastructure projects, and manufacturing transformations through cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated ability to mobilize diverse expertise, make sound technical decisions, and convert complex business needs into sustainable solutions.

• Experience developing engineering talent, building organizational capability, and leading through influence across a geographically dispersed network.


Preferred

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Professional Engineer (PE) certification.

• Lean, TPM, Six Sigma, project management, or reliability certification.


Critical Leadership Competencies

• Servant Leadership and Team Enablement

• Cross-Functional Collaboration and Enterprise Partnership

• Technical Stewardship and Expert Network Leadership

• Strategic and Enterprise Thinking

• Capital Portfolio and Financial Acumen

• Manufacturing and Operational Excellence

• Influence, Alignment, and Stakeholder Management

• Talent Development and Succession Planning

• Change Leadership and Organizational Transformation

• Innovation, Curiosity, and External Orientation

• Judgment, Accountability, and Risk Management

• Learning Agility and Knowledge Sharing


Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a collaborative executive who combines deep technical credibility with strong business judgment and a genuine commitment to serving teams and the enterprise. This leader does not assume that the engineering function alone has the answer. Instead, they ask the right questions, engage the people closest to the work, connect the organization to the strongest available expertise, and create the conditions for teams to develop and execute superior solutions.

They are recognized for building trust across functions, developing talent, raising technical standards, and delivering complex programs through shared ownership and disciplined execution. They balance enterprise consistency with local insight, challenge assumptions constructively, and ensure decisions reflect safety, quality, operational, financial, workforce, and customer needs. They translate long-term strategy into practical action while strengthening capability across a large, geographically dispersed manufacturing network.


Key Experience Requirements

• Led engineering for a multi-site food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or comparable manufacturing network.

• Managed annual capital investments of $150M+ with disciplined governance and demonstrated business outcomes.

• Directed major automation, digital manufacturing, processing, packaging, utilities, facilities, or infrastructure programs.

• Built effective partnerships across Manufacturing, Operations, R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, Quality, EH&S, HR, IT, and Commercial functions.

• Established and leveraged internal and external expert networks to improve technical decisions and project outcomes.

• Demonstrated servant leadership through coaching, barrier removal, talent development, and empowerment of teams.

• Led organizational transformation, capability building, standardization, and culture change across a complex enterprise.

Compensation and Benefits:

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$237,600-$326,700

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.

title: Engineering Industrial Placement
description:
About us

Domo Tactical Communications (DTC) and Domo Broadcast Systems (DBS), both part of the Codan Group, are fast-growing global high-technology companies delivering mission-critical wireless communications and broadcast solutions for the most demanding of environments.

DTC develops leading-edge tactical communications technologies, including its revolutionary MeshUltra™ waveform, providing world-class mesh networking, robust wireless products and IP-centric network devices for mission critical applications.

DBS is a market leader in broadcast solutions, specialising in wireless cameras, remote production (REMI), encoding and decoding, IP mesh and associated technologies. Its ultra-reliable, broadcast-quality, ultra-low latency video and audio solutions are trusted at some of the world’s most prestigious events, including the NFL, World Rally, Formula E, America’s Cup and Eurovision.

Driven by a shared passion for innovation, DTC and DBS develop leading-edge wireless communications technology and solutions in rapidly evolving and challenging environments, from supporting law enforcement and unmanned systems to capturing and sharing the world’s most iconic sporting and live events.

What will you be doing?

The successful applicant will work within an Engineering Team who are world leading experts in Digital Signal Processing, RF Engineering, High Speed Digital Hardware development and software development on both embedded and PC based platforms.

By the end of the industrial placement, we aim to have you actively contribute to the design and release of DTC products! In support of this, during your placement, you will spend time embedded within the various functional teams that, together, ensure the successful delivery of DTC products to our customers.

You will have a passion for teamwork, an inquisitive mind and a “can do attitude” as well as a strong academic background and a keen interest in one or more of the following areas:

  • Embedded Software Development
  • PC Application Software Development
  • Digital Signal Processing
  • Communications Algorithm development and Simulation
  • RF Engineering and RF Hardware Development
  • Baseband Hardware Development
  • Test System Development and ATE Systems

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a motivated, enthusiastic and capable undergraduate to work within either our DTC or DBS Engineering teams over the course of your Industrial Placement.

Requirements:

We are looking for someone who can display many of the following attributes:

  • Strong problem solving skills
  • Adaptability
  • Strong work ethic
  • Excellent communication skills

Qualifications:

  • Must have at least 2 A levels at grade B or above in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics related subjects.
  • On track for a predicted 2:1 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Software, Physics or a related discipline to Engineering

The successful candidate must have the right to work in the UK and be eligible for UK Security Clearance.

Anticipated start date: September 2027

Benefits and Culture

At DTC we value our employees.

Benefits include:

  • A tailored approach to training and development
  • A competitive salary
  • 25 days annual leave plus Bank holidays, prorated
  • Flexible core working hours
  • Modern working environment with onsite subsided café
  • Social events
  • Free onsite parking

Enjoy working as part of a global organisation with teams in Whiteley, Hampshire; USA; Denmark, Singapore; Dubai and Australia.

DTC is committed to promoting a culture that supports personal development and embraces a diverse mix of employees throughout all levels of the organisation.

Interested in a career with us?

Be a part of a growing organisation that drives innovation and excellence, values employees and takes a tailored approach to training and development - if you want to make a difference at DTC, we want to hear from you.

Simply click on APPLY and we will be in contact. Applications will remain open until the 6th December 2026.

title: DevOps Engineer III
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: DevOps Engineer III, 3rd Eye

Operating Company: Environmental Solutions Group - 3rd Eye

Location: Chattanooga, TN

Reports to: DevOps Lead Engineer

Department: Software Engineering

COMPANY SUMMARY:

3rd Eye is disrupting the traditional Fleet Safety Video Monitoring and Telematics industries with leading high-quality media and reliable digital delivery. Our services are engineered for high availability, maximum reach, and cost savings for our customers. Fleet managers can watch live streams or review safety events instantly, from any device, to monitor their vehicle fleet. Our technology is the cornerstone of our industry and our customers use it to improve their fleet safety, operational, and maintenance performance.

POSITION SUMMARY:

3rd Eye is looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer III that can build culture and automation to empower our software delivery teams to deploy continuously. You will help manage our AWS infrastructure, as well as engineering and maintain a fully automated CI/CD pipeline. In addition, you will develop internal standards and work with software delivery teams to provide them with the autonomy necessary to deliver, test and monitor our applications using DevOps best practices.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS INCLUDE:

  • Automate deployment, monitoring, incident response and maintain infrastructure in AWS.
  • Scripting, and software development using one or more programming languages using DRY best practices.
  • Exposure to and maintenance of configuration management tools.
  • Develop and improve best practices for Infrastructure as Code, software build tools and promote CI/CD.
  • Optimize performance, scale out and build resiliency in the platform.
  • Focus on infrastructure cost monitoring to help meet 3rd Eye’s business model expectations.
  • Deployment of system and security patches and updates, including managing the patching platform for servers.
  • Participate in on-call rotations.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science (or other technical discipline with significant computer coursework) or equivalent experience with relevant Professional Certification(s) such as AWS Associate (or other equivalent experience).
  • Experience in 24x7 production operations, preferably deploying H/A, IoT and scalable applications.
  • At least 7 years of experience (in coding and scripting using one or more programming languages.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience with Linux administration.
  • Minimum 4 years of direct Amazon AWS DevOps experience (or equivalent cloud environments).
  • Experience with containerization and infrastructure as code technologies, preferably Terraform, Docker.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, AWS Code Pipeline, Gitlab, or others.
  • Experience with modern software configuration management tools including Salt, Ansible, or others.
  • Significant experience with managing Distributed database clusters (Cassandra/Mongo/ElasticSearch).
  • Familiarity with best practices for well-architected, secure cloud applications.
  • Familiarity with common authentication schemes as 2FA/MFA, Key Pairs, Biometric.
  • Experience working with typical network protocols including TCP/IP, HTTP(/2), TLS, SSH.
  • Excellent oral and written skills.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with container provisioning and management such as AWS ECS, Kubernetes, or AWS EKS.
  • Experience building end-to-end CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, AWS Code Pipeline, Gitlab, or others.
  • Experience creating/maintaining large-scale automated deployments with Salt, Ansible, or others.
  • Significant experience with multiple monitoring and logging tools such as AWS CloudWatch + CloudTrail, Elastic Stack, Grafana + Prometheus, Datadog, and Splunk.
  • Experience in designing, building, architecting of applications and networks.
  • Strong understanding of AWS Security stacks such as GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, SecurityHub, Detective.
  • Knowledge of Cyber Security Frameworks (NIST, ISO).
  • Associate-level AWS Certification a plus, Professional-level a big plus.
  • Proficiency at distilling complex concepts into tangible value-generating initiatives.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Ethics and Work Standards: Maintain the highest ethical and work standards, while promoting the same attributes in co-workers and others. Ensure that all business activities – with both internal and external customers – to be performed with a professional demeanor and that all participants be held accountable to this high standard.

Communication: Expresses thoughts clearly, both orally and in writing, using good grammar. Presents concise, well organized reports in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Listens to understand input, feedback and concerns. Provides complete information in an open, honest and straightforward manner. Responds promptly and positively to questions and requests.

Teamwork and Relationships: Works with other employees willingly and in a spirit of cooperation and teamwork. Supports cooperation. Demonstrates a commitment to the entire business and is supportive of all initiatives (company and departmental) to help grow Environmental Solutions Group business in the United States and abroad. Cooperates fully with others to achieve organizational goals. Is tactful, courteous, and considerate. Embraces a positive outlook. Is respected and trusted by others.

Continual Improvement and Problem Resolution: Identifies and communicates suggestions for work improvements. Uses technical and analytical abilities to assure existing work practices are the most efficient and cost effective possible. Performs root-cause analysis and implements viable, permanent solutions to problems. Works with both internal and external customers to develop solutions which meet company-wide needs and objectives. Applies a sense of urgency to resolve problems or creates opportunities that will increase productivity and create value. Shares best practices with other employees across the business.

Accountability: Accepts responsibility and accessibility for both the strategic planning and the successful implementation of all projects, programs, and duties as outlined in this job description. Advises supervisor of concerns, problems and progress of work in a timely manner.

Terex Overview:

At Terex, we fully embrace the increasingly diverse world around us and strive to create an empowering and welcoming workplace culture. We are a $5 billion publicly traded global industrial equipment manufacturer of materials processing

machinery, waste and recycling solutions, mobile elevating work platforms (MEWPs), and equipment for the electric utility industry. We are passionate about producing equipment that helps improve the lives of people around the world and providing our team members with a rewarding career and the opportunity to make an impact.

While our operations are global, each office or factory is a close-knit community. We value diversity, equity and inclusion, safety, integrity, respect, servant leadership, courage, citizenship, and continuous improvement. description:
If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career.

Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student-focused professionals.
