Pay Range: $91,000.00 - $136,400.00

Job Description

The Learning Resource (LR) Tools Specialist is responsible for the successful implementation, configuration, customization, and troubleshooting of learning resource tools utilized within the institution. The specialist will provide technical expertise, user training, support, and engage with education technology LR Tool Engineers and vendors to ensure the effective integration and functionality of LR tools. Additionally, the specialist will manage partnerships with LR tool vendors, conduct quality assurance and testing, and provide documentation and knowledge sharing to enhance the overall learning experience.

Summary
The Learning Resource (LR) Tools Specialist is responsible for the successful implementation, configuration, customization, and troubleshooting of learning resource tools utilized within the institution. The specialist will provide technical expertise, user training, support, and engage with education technology LR Tool Engineers and vendors to ensure the effective integration and functionality of LR tools. Additionally, the specialist will manage partnerships with LR tool vendors, conduct quality assurance and testing, and provide documentation and knowledge sharing to enhance the overall learning experience.


Job Duties

  • Implements LR tools within the online university environment, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
  • Possesses technical expertise in LR tool configuration and troubleshooting to resolve issues and optimize functionality.
  • Provides user training and support for faculty, staff, and students on the effective use of LR tools.
  • Customizes and configures LR tools to meet the specific needs and requirements of the institution.
  • Engages with education technology LR Tool Engineers to collaborate on enhancements and improvements to LR tool functionality.
  • Manages partnerships with LR tool vendors, including communication, negotiation, and collaboration on tool development and support.
  • Conducts quality assurance and testing of LR tools to ensure reliability, performance, and security.
  • Creates and maintains documentation related to LR tool implementation, configuration, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Shares knowledge and best practices with team members and stakeholders to promote effective use of LR tools.
  • Provides light project management oversight for LR tool implementation and enhancement projects.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

KSAs

  • Strong understanding of learning resource tools commonly used in higher education settings.
  • Proficiency in configuring, customizing, and troubleshooting LR tools such as learning management systems, content authoring tools, virtual classrooms, and assessment platforms.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively train users and collaborate with stakeholders.
  • Ability to engage with education technology LR Tool Engineers and LR tool vendors to drive innovation and resolve technical issues.
  • Experience in quality assurance and testing methodologies for LR tools.
  • Strong documentation skills to create and maintain technical documentation and user guides.
  • Project management skills to oversee LR tool implementation projects and coordinate tasks effectively.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and refining educational programs, courses, and curricula within the higher education sector.
  • Understanding of accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices related to program development and institutional compliance.
  • Proven ability to design and assess curriculum effectiveness, learning outcomes, and student engagement strategies, particularly within a Competency-based Education model.
  • Knowledge of adult learning theories and principles, including instructional design methodologies tailored to adult learners in diverse academic settings.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with academic departments, faculty members, subject matter experts, and instructional designers to develop and deliver high-quality educational programs.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, manage project timelines, and ensure alignment with departmental goals and objectives.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation to inform program development decisions, assess program efficacy, and identify areas for continuous improvement.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, with the ability to articulate program objectives, outcomes, and value propositions to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to explore innovative approaches to program development, incorporate emerging technologies, and adapt to evolving trends and student needs in higher education.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Education, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 2 years of experience in implementing and supporting learning resource tools in a higher education environment.
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in configuring and troubleshooting LR tools.
  • Experience providing user training and support for LR tools.
  • Experience with online learning platforms, learning management systems (LMS), and educational technologies used in online and hybrid learning environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Education, Educational Technology, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Experience in project management related to LR tool implementations.
  • Familiarity with learning analytics and assessment development.
  • Previous experience in evaluating and recommending LR tools for adoption.
  • Certification in educational technology or related areas.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Salary: £43,000 - £48,000

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.


Your Impact

We have an excellent opportunity for a Procurement Data Analyst to join the UK Category Management Organisation within the Procurement & Commercial Function of the Electronics Division. The successful candidate will report to the Head of Direct UK Category Management.

What you will do

  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to gather, understand and report forecast data to enable sourcing and contract activities.
  • Establish and develop Power BI reports.
  • Develop and maintain inflation reports.
  • Develop, manage and report Procurement key performance indicators.
  • Create data dashboards, graphs and visualisations for category strategies and business reviews.
  • Collate and analyse spend and performance related data. Determine and implement actions accordingly.
  • Gather, analyse and report supply risk data in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as point of contact for Procurement reporting, supporting data requests from the Procurement team.
  • Establish strong relationships with stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and with teams to meet requirements and deadlines.
  • Knowledge of design and build quality datasets that enable stakeholders to make decisions, provide business recommendations and solutions.
  • Provide supplier and market intelligence information and analysis to enable effective long-term decision-making and manage risk.
  • Set up and maintain automated data processes.
  • Identify, evaluate and implement solutions to support large volume data validation and cleansing.
  • Monitor and audit data quality.
  • Design and carry out surveys and analyse survey data.
  • Focus on leading indicators and improving the function through effective analysis and reporting.
  • Mine and analyse large datasets, draw valid inferences and present them successfully to management.
  • Active participation in cross business working to support development of data management processes and process policies.

What you will bring

  • Good knowledge in analytics and reporting covering complex range of sub disciplines including – process, performance and supplier risk management.
  • MS Office proficient, with expert level in MS Excel and Power BI.
  • Extensive SAP user experience.
  • Methodical and diligent with good planning abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal/communication and presentation skills, including the proven ability to influence at all levels, internally and externally.
  • Able to work unsupervised and can operate well as part of a team.
  • An understanding of Supply Chain and Procurement principles, techniques and practices
  • Self-motivated, able to identify & drive key issues.
  • Demonstrate collaborative and supportive behaviours. The ability to build strong and trusted relationships to achieve objectives.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit:

Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - ServiceNow Platform Team
description:
Job Family

IT - DevOps Engineering

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit .

Job Description Summary

The Sr. DevOps Engineer is a member of the ServiceNow Platform Team and serves as the primary technical resource supporting the Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) product area. This role partners closely with the SPM Product Owner to deliver roadmap initiatives, enhancements, integrations, and operational improvements while ensuring solutions align with ServiceNow platform architecture, development standards, security requirements, and governance practices. While the primary focus will be SPM, the engineer may also support other ServiceNow products and platform initiatives as business priorities and demand require.

Job Description

What You Will Do:

  • Lead the technical design, development, configuration, and support of ServiceNow SPM solutions.
  • Partner directly with the SPM Product Owner to refine requirements, recommend technical approaches, estimate work, and support prioritization.
  • Translate product roadmap priorities and business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Data Policies, Flow Designer solutions, integrations, and ServiceNow APIs.
  • Design and support integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, and other approved ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout planning, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor developers, and promote secure and maintainable development practices.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex platform and application issues.
  • Support upgrades, release validation, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer.
  • Promote out-of-the-box capabilities, platform standardization, governance, and technical debt reduction.

What You Will Need:

  • Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and configuring solutions within ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management.
  • Experience with SPM capabilities such as Project Portfolio Management, Demand Management, Resource Management, Financial Management, Time Management, and Project Workspace.
  • Advanced ServiceNow development experience, including JavaScript, server-side and client-side scripting, Flow Designer, integrations, and APIs.
  • Ability to independently design scalable solutions and resolve complex technical and application issues.
  • Ability to partner effectively with Product Owners, project teams, architects, business analysts, and stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment.
  • Strong communication, analytical problem-solving, and technical leadership skills.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset with an emphasis on maintainability, standardization, and out-of-the-box capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Active ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification.
  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, management information systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Preferred

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist in Strategic Portfolio Management.
  • Active ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.
  • Experience designing or supporting ServiceNow Platform Analytics, including dashboards, data visualizations, KPIs, scorecards, and portfolio reporting.
  • Experience with Automated Test Framework, platform upgrades, data migration, workspace experiences, and enterprise integrations.
  • Experience mentoring developers or leading technical delivery.

Working Conditions

· Office environment

· Hybrid working conditions 3 days in office.

· Moderate travel

Compensation:

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $109,000 - $141,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days in office per week in one of our hub locations (Denver, Cedar Rapids, Philadelphia). Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

What We Offer

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well-being of our employees.

Benefits Package

Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits

  • Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service.

  • Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars

Inclusion & Diversity

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

Giving Back

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. title: Production Worker - Steel Fabrication (Days)
description:
Powell People Solving Tough Problems

As a top player in Switchgear and E-house Manufacturing and field servicing, a career with us will challenge you to solve some very tough problems. You will be rewarded with growth, personal development & industry expertise. At Powell, we provide a comprehensive salary package, RRSP matching, extensive benefits and job training all within a professional & friendly working environment.

Based out of the Electrical Division Edmonton (EDE) location, the Production Worker - Steel Fab will report to the Manufacturing Supervisor of the Fabrication department. Under the direction and guidance of the Fab Machine Operator the Production Worker - Steel Fab will use a variety of skills and tools to produce precision parts and construct Powell Canada products.

Essential Responsibilities

Assist with daily and weekly preventative maintenance of the metal working machinery.
Move parts from one manufacturing operation to the next, according to the part routing.
Loading and unloading of steel or other product from trucks (indoor/outdoor).
Assist with shop and yard organization.
Assist machine operators with various tasks upon request.
Remove finished parts from sheet metal skeletons.
De-burring, grinding or finishing of metal parts using all types of air/electric grinders or sanders.
Sort and stack parts by part number & job number combination.
Assemble kits of parts to be welded.
Operate pallet jack, forklift and cranes.
Knowledge and ability to use general hand tools such as hammers, screwdrivers, wrenches, vise grips, etc.
On occasion, required to perform labor tasks such as painting, grinding, sanding or general cleaning tasks as directed by Supervisor or Lead Person.
Promote a safety culture as well as attend all safety meetings.
Ensures quality by following standard work instructions and identifying any potential risks to product quality.
Ensure work area remains clean and well organized.
Other duties as required.

Core Competencies

Ability to read a tape measure (including conversions from fraction to decimal and conversely from decimal to fraction and metric to imperial).
Conscientious, thorough, accurate, and reliable when performing and completing job tasks.
Ability to learn and adhere to all manufacturing policies and practices to ensure adherence to ISO requirements.
Able to work effectively within a team and around other departments and their activities.
Must have a basic command of the English language, both written and verbal.

Qualifications

Minimum education level of a High School Diploma is required.
1-2 year metal fabrication shop experience is considered an asset.
Safety certifications are an asset for this position.

Work Authorization: This is a permanent position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire. Immigration sponsorship is not typically available and will be considered only where supported by business needs and applicable legal requirements.

Working Conditions

Working with hot temperatures.
Safety sensitive position in a temperature controlled manufacturing or industrial environment with occasional outside activities.
Required to wear personnel protective equipment at all times (i.e., hard hats, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety harnesses as required) and respirators when required.
Must be able to work from all type of ladders (step ladders, "A" frame ladders and all size extension ladders) and scaffolding.
Working at heights usually no higher than 30 feet in the air on or using proper lift equipment.

Physical Requirements

Able to maintain body equilibrium and agility to prevent falling when walking, standing, crouching, ascending or descending stairs.
Bending the body at the waist, the legs at the knees, and extending arms and hands in any direction in a repetitive manner continuously.
Continuous standing, walking 50-300 foot distances for long periods of time with only occasional sitting.
Must be able to climb stairs frequently throughout the shift.
Able to frequently look over shoulders, work with both arms above shoulders and use both arms at full length frequently.
Using upper extremities to apply or exert a force continuously up to 50lbs.
Ability to use hand tools such as tin snips, hammer, and power tools (some vibrating), for long periods of time with frequent repetition.

Who we are

Powell Canada Inc. is a subsidiary of Powell Industries, which is located in Houston, Texas. Globally, we have over 70 years of experience. Powell Canada is a reputable electrical manufacturing and electrical/instrumentation contracting company. We hold a strong industry presence with offices located in Acheson, Calgary and Montreal.

Powell strives to create one unified company through training, communication and leadership. We offer diversified services based on our customer’s needs, keeping us on the cutting edge of new products and services within our industry.

Your Partner in Safety

Successful candidates must have legal authorization to work in Canada on a full-time basis for any employer, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Powell Canada, Inc is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Facility Security Officer
description:
At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit . Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

Position Overview:
As our Facility Security Officer, you will collaborate closely with the security and safety personnel in implementing local, corporate, and Department of Energy (DOE) facility security requirements to ensure compliance, safety and security of the facility, its employees, visitors, and assets. This role involves the implementation and enforcement of security protocols, conducting regular inspections, and coordinating with law enforcement as necessary. The officer will also handle incident reports and maintain communication with management regarding security matters.

Location:

On-site in Euclid, Ohio

Your Day to Day as a Facility Security Officer:

  • Monitor and control access to the facility, ensuring all security protocols are followed.
  • Conduct regular security patrols of the premises, including interior and exterior areas, to identify and address potential security hazards.
  • Maintain visitor logs and ensure that all visitors have appropriate access credentials.
  • Conduct investigations of security incidents or breaches, documenting findings and reporting them to management.
  • Assist in the development, implementation, and maintenance of facility security policies and procedures.
  • Regularly review and update security systems and technology to enhance facility security.
  • Provide training to employees on security awareness and emergency procedures.
  • Coordinate with local law enforcement and emergency services during emergencies or incidents.
  • Maintain all security records and reports in compliance with organizational policies.
  • Maintain comprehensive administrative knowledge of site access control systems and assist personnel in submitting access requests.
  • Assist with providing direction to the contract guard personnel providing security on-site 24/7.
  • Prepare and facilitate the processing of DOE security clearances, maintaining detailed records in compliance with government regulations.
  • Additional tasks and responsibilities as assigned by management to support the Security Program.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, or a related field; advanced degrees or professional security certifications (e.g., CPP, PSP) strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience in a security or access control role experience preferably with a customer service focus.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging and influencing employees and leaders of diverse backgrounds and generations.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in leveraging data to inform decision-making.
  • Trustworthy, capable of handling sensitive information appropriately, and able to interact professionally with various disciplines and personalities.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.
  • Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.
  • An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.
  • The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Pay: $70,000 - $103,000

The base salary range for this position in Ohio (US-OH) at the start of employment is expected to be between $70,000 and $103,000 per year. However, the base salary offered is based on local job market factors, and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to these considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, such as an annual cash incentive in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and/or other benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided at such time the selected job candidate receives an offer of employment. If hired, the selected job candidate will be employed 'at-will,’ unless employed at a location and in a position subject to a collective bargaining agreement. The company further reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment, compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and other market factors.

As a federal government contractor, BWX Technologies, Inc. and any subsidiaries, affiliates and related entities (“BWXT” or the “Company”) complies with all federal, state, and local laws and customer requirements regarding health and safety protocols. As such, all BWXT new hires will be required to adhere to applicable Company health and safety requirements within the workplace as a condition of employment.

All candidates must be U.S. citizens. Selected applicants are required to successfully complete a pre-employment check and drug screening. In addition, the position may require the ability to obtain and maintain applicable federal eligibility requirements for access to classified/sensitive information or matter which involves an extensive criminal and financial background investigation, drug test, previous employment, and reference verifications.

BWXT is committed to the concept of Equal Employment Opportunity. We have established procedures to ensure that all personnel actions such as recruitment, compensation, career development, benefits, company-sponsored training and social recreational programs are administered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, protected veteran or other protected status.

title: Remote Grading Assistant - Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) II (Spring 2027) - College of Engineering and Technology
description:
Help Shape Student Success at Grand Canyon University


Grand Canyon University is seeking motivated and detail-oriented professionals to serve as Grading Assistants for the traditional ground campus within the College of Engineering and Technology. This is an exciting opportunity to support student learning, collaborate with faculty, and make a meaningful impact in higher education — all from the comfort of your home.


This is a fully remote, asynchronous, part-time opportunity ideal for individuals passionate about academics, mentorship, and student success. Grading Assistants support instructors through grading and virtual classroom assistance responsibilities but do not perform teaching or instructional duties.


Position placement will be based on qualifications and academic background.


Why Join GCU?

  • Fully remote and flexible asynchronous schedule
  • Opportunity to support and engage with university student
  • Collaborate with experienced faculty members
  • Gain valuable experience in higher education
  • Be part of a mission-driven university dedicated to student success

Course: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) II

Continuation of the SDLC process and delivery methodologies, including the various tools, artifacts, and delivery methodologies is explored. Traditional system and software delivery methodologies as well as agile and lean delivery methodologies will be discussed. An understanding of selecting the correct development life cycle (methodology), creating realistic plans, and managing a project team through each project phase is examined. Students must complete a programming project of mid-level complexity and delivery of a sizeable software product by a student team.


Qualifications:

To be considered, applicants must:

  • Hold a completed Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution at the time of application with completed course credits in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline
  • Demonstrate strong communication, organization, and attention to detail
  • Be comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Responsibilities:


As a Grading Assistant, you will:

  • Assist instructors with grading assignments and coursework
  • Maintain regular communication with assigned faculty
  • Monitor student performance and communicate concerns to the instructor
  • Stay current on course materials, schedules, and classroom activities
  • Record and track relevant student progress information
  • Serve as a positive representative of Grand Canyon University by supporting the University’s Mission, Doctrinal Statement, and Ethical Position Statement

Join a university committed to transforming lives through education and become part of a team that empowers students to achieve their goals.


Apply today to help support the next generation of learners at Grand Canyon University.

title: Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver)
location: United States of America, Frisco, Texas
description:
Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver)

Job Description:

Accounting firms are reinventing how they prepare tax returns, and their clients, taxpayers expect a simple, secure, digital way to hand over documents and get a finished return. Firms expect everything in between to be faster, more automated, and connected to the tools they already run. SafeSend is where that happens: the taxpayer-facing perimeter and engine of Tax Workflow for accounting firm clients, the surface taxpayers touch, and, through its APIs, the engine firms build their own workflows on.

As Director of Product for SafeSend, you will own that surface and lead its evolution into an AI-driven, agentic gather-prepare-deliver experience on Thomson Reuters’ CoCounsel platform and open it up so firms and partners can build on it.

The opportunity:

  • Firms are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
  • Taxpayers expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive their return.
  • Document data extraction is going AI-native; firms want agentic preparation and review and are adopting it now.
  • Firms increasingly want to build on open APIs so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
  • SafeSend sits at the center of all four. This is a build-and-converge mandate — shaping a market-defining product, not maintaining a mature one.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver SafeSend. Own the SafeSend portfolio end to end — Gather, Organizers, e-Sign, Delivery, Returns and Extensions — season over season, at the reliability and scale that tax-filing peaks demand.
  • Converge SafeSend and TaxCaddy. Bring the best of SafeSend and TaxCaddy together into one Gather & Deliver experience for every firm and taxpayer
  • Componentize the portfolio. Turn each part of SafeSend into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the gather – prepare – deliver flow and used across the broader CoCounsel platform, rather than locked inside a single app.
  • Enable expanded SafeSend access via APIs and orchestration. Expand the SafeSend API surface — open APIs, events and integrations — as a first-class capability, so firms and partners embed SafeSend in their own portals and workflows and keep their tools, data and reporting connected, with orchestration so AI agents and partner systems can coordinate gather and delivery programmatically.
  • Deliver agentic Gather & Deliver through CoCounsel. Bring agentic Gather — and AI-driven extraction, preparation and review — into the SafeSend experience on the CoCounsel platform, so more of the work shifts from staff to the platform while the firm stays in control.

What success looks like:

  • Firms experience one connected Gather & Deliver workflow, whatever ecosystem they run today.
  • The SafeSend API is something firms and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
  • Firms reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through SafeSend, season over season.
  • Taxpayers get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience — and firms see measurably less manual work.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in product management, including leading a product line at scale as a Director or senior PM.
  • Experience building and productizing platform, API or developer-facing products — not only features on top of them.
  • A track record of converging or migrating products without disrupting existing customers.
  • Fluency with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
  • Strong systems thinking — able to see a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
  • Experience in the tax & accounting workflow space strongly preferred
  • Strong stakeholder management and a proven record of building high-performing teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in tax & accounting, fintech, or document / data-processing workflows.
  • Experience partnering with large, demanding enterprise customers as design partners.
  • Comfort owning commercially consequential product decisions.
  • Advanced business or technical degree preferred

description:
Senior Agile Program Manager – MQ-9 / Special Projects

Job Description

Sumaria Systems is seeking a Senior Agile Program Manager supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Medium Altitude Unmanned Aircraft Systems (MAUAS) Division. This position provides acquisition management, special projects, and Agile project management support for the MQ-9 program, helping Government and industry teams translate operational requirements into capabilities for the warfighter.

Working with Government program managers, technical teams, and operational stakeholders, you will support program planning, integration, fielding, and sustainment. This role combines senior acquisition expertise with practical Agile experience to coordinate complex initiatives, support special operations center requirements, and guide incremental capability delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Provide acquisition management, program planning, and integration support across MQ-9 research, development, production, fielding, and lifecycle sustainment activities.

  • Analyze and monitor program cost, schedule, and performance; identify issues; and recommend corrective actions and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Develop and coordinate acquisition management plans, project schedules, financial plans, roadmaps, briefings, correspondence, and program review materials.

  • Support the development and review of statements of work, Contract Data Requirements Lists, program protection plans, and other acquisition documentation.

  • Assist with financial and acquisition management activities, including coordination and tracking of contracts, invoices, and contract modifications.

  • Analyze operational requirements and coordinate with engineering, logistics, contracting, financial management, and operational stakeholders to address integration, supportability, certification, and equipment readiness concerns.

  • Support configuration management, testing, aircraft delivery coordination, Contractor Logistics Support, depot transition, and planning for system upgrades and improvements.

  • Coordinate Government and contractor activities supporting the establishment and sustainment of Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC) operations centers.

  • Work with MQ-9 program teams and U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM) enterprise network representatives to ensure special operations requirements are understood and addressed during integration, fielding, and sustainment.

  • Support major program reviews and facilitate the submission, review, and approval process for accreditation documentation through the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS) and Platform IT accreditation process.

  • Provide technical and Agile project management expertise as Government and contractor teams define requirements, processes, data models, services, system specifications, and architectures.

  • Work with customers to gather requirements, model use cases, write user stories, and document business processes.

  • Support Government stakeholders in defining product vision, prioritizing capabilities, identifying program increment features, and breaking those features into manageable deliverables.

  • Apply Agile development practices that support iterative and incremental development, continuous integration, and demonstrable interim software deliveries.

  • Facilitate release planning sessions and provide recommendations on feature selection and delivery priorities, with final release content decisions retained by the Government.

  • Maintain program metrics, track actions, facilitate meetings, and recommend improvements to program processes.

  • Apply senior-level expertise to resolve complex program issues and provide technical guidance to junior and journeyman personnel.

Required Skills/Education

Education and Years of Experience: Meet one of the following combinations:

  • Master’s degree and at least 12 years of relevant experience, including 5 years supporting DoD; or

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 15 years of relevant experience, including 5 years supporting DoD; or

  • At least 20 years of directly related experience, including 8 years supporting DoD, with applicable certifications.

Additional qualifications include:

  • Advanced knowledge of acquisition and program management, with the ability to independently assess complex issues and recommend solutions.

  • Knowledge of Waterfall and Agile project management methodologies.

  • Experience managing projects using Agile approaches such as Scrum, Kanban, Extreme Programming, or SAFe.

  • Understanding of Agile values, principles, and practices, including iterative and incremental development and continuous integration.

  • Demonstrated experience gathering customer requirements, modeling use cases, writing user stories, and documenting business processes.

  • Ability to assess program cost, schedule, performance, and risk and provide actionable recommendations to Government leadership.

  • Knowledge of acquisition planning, requirements documentation, configuration control, testing, and lifecycle sustainment processes.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and oversee the efforts of junior and journeyman personnel.

  • Strong analytical writing, briefing, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

  • Experience with AFSOC operations centers, eMASS, and SOCOM C4ISR programs is highly desired.

Travel: Yes
Security Clearance Required: Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI)

Work Location: On-Site WPAFB, OH

Support the MQ-9 mission by connecting acquisition planning, operational requirements, and Agile delivery. Apply your experience alongside Government and industry professionals to advance capabilities supporting the warfighter and specialized mission requirements.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

Position Overview:

The Rotordynamics Development and Testing Engineer will spearhead engineering process innovation and rigorous testing activities to support the manufacturing of gas centrifuges for UF6 enrichment. This role demands a proven background in rotordynamics and dynamic testing, coupled with expertise in signal processing and software development. The ideal candidate will adeptly follow established engineering protocols while driving new methodologies for enhanced centrifuge design and production.

Location:

Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

Your day to day as a Rotordynamics Development and Testing Engineer:

  • Serve as the resident expert on rotordynamics, leveraging current methodologies and developing avant-garde techniques to optimize centrifuge manufacturing and design processes.
  • Champion both experimental investigations and model-based simulations to resolve complex rotordynamics challenges, ensuring design robustness and operational efficiency.
  • Architect and guide the construction of advanced test systems, encompassing state-of-the-art data acquisition, digital signal processing architectures, and high-speed signal analysis to capture critical performance metrics.
  • Lead initiatives in dynamic testing for system balancing, utilizing a spectrum of techniques — from traditional influence coefficient methods to comprehensive experimental modal analysis and innovative hybrid approaches.
  • Independently execute sophisticated engineering projects, making informed decisions that reflect a deep understanding of underlying principles and industry best practices.
  • Prepare, document, and present both routine and in-depth engineering reports, ensuring clear communication of testing protocols, results, and recommendations to key stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering with 6 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering with 3 years of targeted industry experience, or a Doctor of Philosophy degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas:
    • Rotordynamics and associated problem-solving techniques
    • Dynamic testing methodologies in high-speed systems
    • Advanced digital signal processing (DSP) methods
    • Software development using languages and tools such as Python, C++, MATLAB, etc.
    • Finite Element Analysis (FEA) using platforms like ANSYS
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy ‘Q’ clearance.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degrees (Master of Science or higher) in Mechanical Engineering are highly desirable.
  • Candidates with extensive hands-on experience in the field and a proven track record of leading complex engineering projects will be favored.
  • Possession of an active DOE Q Clearance is an added advantage.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.
  • Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.
  • An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.
  • The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

  • Ensure quality, security, and operational excellence – Design and implement testing, monitoring, and observability for AI systems at scale; ensure compliance with ethical AI principles, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with AWS and with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, and a record of integrating AI models into large-scale production systems through APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong technical leadership and mentoring experience as an individual contributor, with the communication skills to influence senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience leading technical direction for teams building agent-based systems or enterprise integrations with AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
  • Advanced knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and information retrieval.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, including graph data modeling, ontologies and taxonomies, graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and combining graphs with LLMs through approaches such as GraphRAG and entity extraction.

  • Successful AI product launches and experience scaling AI systems to enterprise customers.
  • Experience with AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Publications, patents, or speaking experience in AI/ML.Jon

description:
Powell People Solving Tough Problems

  • Ability to adapt to new ideas, technology, processes or product changes.

  • Must have a basic command of the English language, both written and verbal.

  • Knowledge of machines and tools including their design, use, repair and maintenance.
  • Basic computer knowledge considered and asset.

  • Safety training certificates are an asset for the position.

Work Authorization: This is a permanent position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire. Immigration sponsorship is not typically available and will be considered only where supported by business needs and applicable legal requirements.

  • Safety sensitive position in a temperature controlled manufacturing or industrial environment with occasional outside activities.
  • Required to wear personnel protective equipment at all times (i.e., hard hats, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety harnesses as required) and respirators when required.
  • Must be able to work from all type of ladders (step ladders, "A" frame ladders and all size extension ladders) and scaffolding.
  • Working at heights usually no higher than 30 feet in the air on or using proper lift equipment.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to maintain body equilibrium and agility to prevent falling when walking, standing, crouching, ascending or descending stairs.
  • Bending the body at the waist, the legs at the knees, and extending arms and hands in any direction in a repetitive manner continuously.
  • Continuous standing, walking 50-300 foot distances for long periods of time with only occasional sitting.
  • Must be able to climb stairs frequently throughout the shift.
  • Able to frequently look over shoulders, work with both arms above shoulders and use both arms at full length frequently.
  • Using upper extremities to apply or exert a force continuously up to 50lbs.
  • Ability to use hand tools such as tin snips, hammer, and power tools (some vibrating), for long periods of time with frequent repetition.

Who we are

Powell Canada Inc. is a subsidiary of Powell Industries, which is located in Houston, Texas. Globally, we have over 70 years of experience. Powell Canada is a reputable electrical manufacturing, valve servicing and electrical/instrumentation contracting company. We hold a strong industry presence with offices located in Acheson, Calgary and Montreal.

Powell strives to create one unified company through training, communication and leadership. We offer diversified services based on our customer’s needs, keeping us on the cutting edge of new products and services within our industry.

Your Partner in Safety

description:
We are looking for an experienced Health & Injury Management Specialist to join our Health and Injury Management team within EHS.


In this role, you’ll provide specialist occupational health, injury management and wellbeing advice and services, helping to manage workplace health risks, support employees through recovery and return to work, and contribute to a safe and healthy workplace.


This role reports into the Lead, Health & Injury Management.


The Role


Your key responsibilities will include:


  • Manage early intervention and injury management, including non-work-related injuries, occupational rehabilitation and complex cases, supporting effective recovery and return to work.
  • Coordinate occupational health surveillance programs, including vaccinations, health fitness assessments, pathology services, audiometric testing and other required health assessments.
  • Manage the delivery of health surveillance services through external providers.
  • Support and implement workplace wellbeing programs and initiatives, including reviewing health and injury trends and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Manage onsite ergonomics activities, including workstation, worksite and manual handling assessments.
  • Support the delivery of first aid services, including risk assessments, training, equipment and auditing.
  • Provide emergency injury and illness management for employees and contractors, including initial provision of first aid and, where required, referral to other health professionals where required.
  • Review injury statistics and health data to identify trends and opportunities for preventative action.
  • Support EHS projects, continuous improvement activities and audit readiness
  • Provide health and injury management advice to stakeholders and EHS committees and deliver manual handling and other relevant training

About You


To be successful in this role, you’ll bring:


  • A qualification as a health professional, such as an Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Registered Nurse, Osteopath or Chiropractor.
  • A postgraduate qualification in occupational health management or equivalent.
  • Occupational Health First Aid certification.
  • At least 5 years’ experience within an occupational health environment, such as onsite occupational health, injury management or a rehabilitation provider.
  • Strong knowledge of safety and workers’ compensation legislation and regulations.
  • Experience designing, implementing and evaluating workplace wellbeing programs.
  • Strong communication, influencing, reporting and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to manage projects independently while working collaboratively across the organisation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and case management software

title: Senior Analyst, Compliance - Products
location: United States of America, Eagan, Minnesota
description:
Job Description

The Compliance team is accountable for managing compliance activities to ensure customer, employee, and third-party adherence to Thomson Reuters policies, third-party requirements, and regulatory obligations. Within Compliance, the Segment Compliance team gives each major business segment a named compliance owner — this role owns that mandate for Products — a horizontal segment spanning compliance-by-design work across TR’s product portfolio.


Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Segment Compliance & Assurance Partnership, this Senior Analyst will serve as the primary compliance point of contact for the Products segment. Given the breadth of the segment relative to current team capacity, this role is expected to prioritize the highest-risk products and use cases rather than attempt even coverage across everything in scope. The role also continues the misuse investigations and content-protection work that has always sat with this team, and contributes to the team’s growing partnership with Risk’s Assurance Hub — helping turn flagged signals into root-cause fixes with business partners rather than one-off reports.


This is a key position within the Legal, Risk & Compliance (LR&C) program, sitting alongside segment-aligned peers covering Legal Professionals (including Risk & Fraud), Corporates, Marketing & Comms, TAAP, and Operations & Technology. The ideal candidate combines strong product and business compliance instincts with comfort operating autonomously in a segment coverage model that is still being built out, and is energized by helping shape that model as it matures.


This position offers significant opportunity for growth as Segment Compliance's coverage model matures. The successful candidate will help define what strong compliance ownership of the Products segment looks like, build visibility with product and segment leadership, and be well-positioned for advancement into management as the model — and the candidate's role in it — scales. This role suits an experienced compliance professional who is motivated as much by building something new as by executing an established playbook.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own compliance strategy and execution for the Products segment, prioritizing the highest-risk products and use cases rather than attempting uniform coverage across every product in scope
  • Conduct misuse investigations, use-case vetting, and customer reviews within the Products segment, continuing the team’s existing content-protection and monitoring work
  • Partner with product, legal, sales, and segment leadership on regulatory compliance obligations, third-party requirements, and business policy adherence specific to assigned products
  • Support Compliance by Design work with product and engineering teams so compliance is considered at inception for new products and features, not retrofitted after launch — this is the core, horizontal focus of the Products segment
  • Contribute segment-level insight to the team’s partnership with Risk’s Assurance Hub — helping translate flagged signals into root-cause analysis and mitigation plans with business partners
  • Leverage AI tools, automation platforms, and analytics to strengthen monitoring, risk identification, and reporting for the segment
  • Lead execution of compliance policies and processes relevant to Products from design through implementation; take ownership of related third-party and internal audit requests and remediation
  • Support compliance training and employee communications related to product compliance obligations and policy updates
  • Provide litigation support and conduct legal/compliance research as needed; assist with document and contract analysis
  • Mentor junior compliance staff and contribute to team capability-building as the Segment Compliance model matures
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of business, legal, or compliance experience, with demonstrated expertise in product or business compliance management and regulatory risk assessment

Position Overview:

As our Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of design, analysis, and prototyping activities for new nuclear systems through testing, documentation review, and oversight.

Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

Your Day to Day as a Quality Assurance Engineer:

  • Identify quality requirements for procurements.
  • Assist with supplier evaluations and qualification through audits, assessments, and surveillances.
  • Review supplier quality documentation.
  • Assist with and review disposition of nonconformances.
  • Participate in quality program development including preparation of quality plans and procedures.
  • Participate in periodic internal audits, surveillances, and assessments.
  • Evaluate the adequacy and completeness of corrective actions and lead root cause analysis.
  • Support additional assignments as assigned by management.

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a STEM or related field is required.
  • A minimum of ten (10) years of relevant experience is required, including at least five (5) years of experience in quality engineering in the nuclear, defense, or aerospace industry.
  • Must have strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to multi-task.
  • Must have a demonstrated understanding and implementation of quality standards such as NQA-1, ISO 9001, AS9100D, ASME, NCA-4000, or NASA requirements.
  • Must have demonstrated proficiency in generating technical reports and presentations using MS Office Applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Project.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of government regulations applied to quality assurance including 10 CFR50 App. B, 10 CFR 830.120, DOE O 414.1 and 10 CFR 71 is desired.
  • Experience as NQA-1 or ISO 9001/AS9100 auditor is desired.
  • Knowledge of inspection tools, systems, and techniques is desired.
  • Knowledge of Commercial Grade Dedication (CGD) of item, services and software is desired.

title: ELI - Strategic Planning Specialist
description:
Job Description:

Leonardo is an international industrial group and one of the world's leading companies in the Aerospace, Defence, and Security sectors, delivering multi-domain technological capabilities in the fields of Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cyber Security, and Space. With more than 60,000 employees worldwide, the company has a strong industrial presence in Italy, the United Kingdom, Poland, and the United States, and operates in 150 countries through subsidiaries, joint ventures, and equity investments. A key player in major strategic programs at the global level, Leonardo is a technology and industrial partner to governments, defence administrations, institutions, and businesses.


We are looking for a Strategic & Growth Planning Specialist to support the development of the Division’s strategic and growth agenda, ensuring coherence between strategic priorities, investments and resource allocation.

The role contributes to the identification, assessment and prioritization of new growth opportunities, evaluating their strategic rationale, feasibility, investment requirements and expected business returns.

The position also provides fact-based analysis to support investment decisions, while contributing to Corporate-led inorganic growth initiatives and the identification of external funding opportunities.


Activities

  • Support the translation of the Strategic Plan into strategic initiatives, investment priorities and resource requirements.
  • Assess the alignment of investment plans and resource allocation with the Division’s strategic priorities, identifying potential gaps and areas requiring further assessment.
  • Scout and assess new growth opportunities across markets, products, technologies and business models, evaluating strategic rationale, attractiveness and feasibility.
  • Develop fact-based assessments and preliminary business cases for growth initiatives, including expected business returns, investment requirements, key risks and strategic fit.
  • Support the prioritization and evolution of the growth initiatives portfolio, contributing to management reviews and strategic decision-making.
  • Support Corporate-led inorganic growth initiatives, assessing their strategic fit, business rationale and potential implications for the Division.
  • Identify and assess potential external funding opportunities for strategic initiatives and programmes, supporting their alignment with the Division’s strategic and technology priorities.

Requirements - Profile & Skills

  • Master’s degree in Engineering (with focus on management disciplines), Economics, Business Administration or other STEM disciplines.
  • 2–4 years of experience in strategy, strategic planning, business development, corporate finance or business analysis in complex/industrial environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex topics and translate analyses into clear business implications.
  • Good understanding of business case development, investment assessment and financial fundamentals.
  • Ability to assess growth opportunities combining strategic, market and financial perspectives.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Power BI or similar analytical tools is a plus.
  • Ability to operate effectively across functions, working with Strategy, Finance, Business, Engineering and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and synthesis skills, with the ability to prepare clear materials to support management decision-making.
  • Ability to operate in cross-functional and international environments.
  • Good written and spoken English communication skills (B2 or above).

Engagement, recognition of skills, and a strong focus on people's well-being and safety are the cornerstones of our corporate culture.
Every day, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and stimulating work environment by actively promoting the principles of inclusion, equity, and diversity enhancement.
